summary.it: Il periodo è dominato dagli attacchi israeliani a Gaza, tra cui un attacco a un ospedale condannato da molti paesi e l'uccisione di un alto comandante di Hamas, insieme a una tesa situazione politica post-elettorale e a controversie sugli insediamenti. summary.ar: تهيمن على الفترة الضربات الإسرائيلية على غزة، بما في ذلك ضربة استهدفت مستشفى أدانتها دول عديدة، ومقتل قائد كبير في حماس، إلى جانب توتر سياسي بعد الانتخابات وخلافات حول المستوطنات. كانت الأسواق مختلطة، إذ انخفض مؤشر TA-35 بنسبة 0.88% خلال اليوم لكنه ارتفع بنسبة 2.46% خلال الأسبوع، ونبرة الأخبار السلبية قوية.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر حملات اسرائیل به غزه است، از جمله حمله به یک بیمارستان که بسیاری از کشورها آن را محکوم کردند و کشته شدن یکی از فرماندهان ارشد حماس، و همچنین تنش‌های سیاسی پس از انتخابات و اختلاف‌ها بر سر شهرک‌سازی. بازارها متفاوت بودند: شاخص TA-35 در این روز 0.88% کاهش یافت اما در طول هفته 2.46% افزایش داشت و لحن منفی اخبار قوی است.
summary.zh: 这一时期主要受以色列对加沙的袭击主导，包括一起遭多国谴责的医院遭袭事件，以及一名哈马斯高级指挥官被杀，同时选举后的政治局势紧张，定居点问题也存在争议。市场表现不一：TA-35指数当日下跌0.88%，但当周上涨2.46%，负面新闻的基调十分强烈。
summary.tr: Dönem, Gazze'deki İsrail saldırılarının etkisi altındadır. Bunlar arasında birçok ülkenin kınadığı bir hastane saldırısı ve üst düzey bir Hamas komutanının öldürülmesi yer alır. Seçim sonrası gergin siyaset ve yerleşim tartışmaları da öne çıkmaktadır. Piyasalar karışık seyretti: TA-35 gün içinde %0.88 düşerken haftalık bazda %2.46 yükseldi. Olumsuz haber tonu güçlüdür.
summary.es: El período está dominado por los ataques israelíes en Gaza, entre ellos un ataque contra un hospital condenado por numerosos países y el asesinato de un alto comandante de Hamás. Junto a ello, destacan la tensa situación política posterior a las elecciones y las disputas por los asentamientos. Los mercados fueron mixtos: el TA-35 cayó un 0.88% en la jornada, pero subió un 2.46% en la semana. El tono negativo de las noticias es fuerte.

summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από τους ισραηλινούς βομβαρδισμούς στη Γάζα, συμπεριλαμβανομένου ενός πλήγματος σε νοσοκομείο που καταδικάστηκε από πολλές χώρες και της δολοφονίας ενός ανώτερου διοικητή της Χαμάς, παράλληλα με την τεταμένη μετεκλογική πολιτική κατάσταση και τις διαφορές για τους εποικισμούς. summary.es: El periodo combina novedades positivas, como el acuerdo de defensa con Qatar, un supuesto descubrimiento de petróleo y los planes de contratistas nucleares, con presión sobre los críticos y protestas, incluida la indignación por las 19 muertes de trabajadores en HABAŞ. summary.fr: La période mêle des évolutions positives, comme l'accord de défense avec le Qatar, une découverte pétrolière signalée et les projets de contractants nucléaires, à une pression exercée sur les critiques et à des manifestations, notamment la colère suscitée par la mort de 19 travailleurs chez HABAŞ. summary.de: Der Zeitraum vereint positive Entwicklungen, etwa das Verteidigungsabkommen mit Katar, einen gemeldeten Ölfund und Pläne nuklearer Auftragnehmer, mit Druck auf Kritiker und Protesten, darunter die Empörung über den Tod von 19 Arbeitern bei HABAŞ. summary.pt: O período combina avanços positivos, como o acordo de defesa com o Catar, uma descoberta de petróleo noticiada e planos de empreiteiras nucleares, com pressão sobre críticos e protestos, incluindo a indignação com as 19 mortes de trabalhadores na HABAŞ. O tom negativo do GDELT fica bem abaixo da média mundial, mas o BIST 100 subiu 0,27% no dia e 3,14% na semana, de modo que o saldo se aproxima de um dia comum.

summary.es: El período es en su mayoría rutinario: conmemoraciones del aniversario del Politécnico, avisos del metro y del tiempo, y cobertura continua de la disputa por el cable entre Grecia y Chipre. Las señales positivas incluyen el acceso al mercado chino para las cerezas griegas, las cotizaciones en la Bolsa de Atenas en un máximo de 20 años y una modesta subida semanal del índice, compensadas por la muerte de dos bomberos y la tensión continuada con Turquía.
summary.fr: La période est en grande partie routinière : commémorations de l'anniversaire de l'École polytechnique, avis de métro et de météo, et couverture continue du différend sur le câble entre la Grèce et Chypre. Les signaux positifs comprennent l'accès du marché chinois aux cerises grecques, des introductions à la Bourse d'Athènes au plus haut depuis 20 ans et une modeste hausse hebdomadaire de l'indice, contrebalancés par la mort de deux pompiers et la tension persistante avec la Turquie.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft größtenteils routinemäßig: Gedenkveranstaltungen zum Jubiläum der Polytechnischen Hochschule, Hinweise zu U-Bahn und Wetter sowie laufende Berichte über den Streit um das Kabel zwischen Griechenland und Zypern. Positive Signale sind der chinesische Marktzugang für griechische Kirschen, Börsengänge an der Athener Börse auf einem 20-Jahres-Hoch und ein moderater wöchentlicher Anstieg des Index, dem der Tod zweier Feuerwehrleute und die anhaltenden Spannungen mit der Türkei gegenüberstehen.
summary.pt: O período é em grande parte rotineiro: comemorações do aniversário da Politécnica, avisos do metrô e do tempo, e cobertura contínua da disputa sobre o cabo entre a Grécia e Chipre. Os sinais positivos incluem o acesso ao mercado chinês para as cerejas gregas, as listagens na Bolsa de Atenas no maior nível em 20 anos e um modesto ganho semanal do índice, compensados pelas mortes de dois bombeiros e pela tensão contínua com a Turquia.
summary.ja: 期間の大半は日常的な出来事で占められている。ポリテクニオ記念日の追悼行事、地下鉄と気象に関する通知、そしてギリシャとキプロスを結ぶ海底ケーブルを巡る紛争の継続的な報道である。前向きな材料としては、ギリシャ産サクランボの中国市場への参入、アテネ証券取引所の上場数が20年ぶりの高水準にあること、そして株価指数の週間の緩やかな上昇が挙げられる。一方、消防士2名の死亡とトルコとの緊張の継続がこれを相殺している。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 소식으로 채워졌다. 폴리테크닉 기념일 추모 행사, 지하철 및 기상 안내, 그리스와 키프로스를 잇는 해저 케이블 분쟁에 대한 지속적인 보도가 이어졌다. 긍정적인 신호로는 그리스산 체리의 중국 시장 진출, 아테네 증권거래소 상장 기업 수가 20년 만의 최고치를 기록한 점, 지수의 주간 소폭 상승이 있었다. 반면 소방관 2명의 사망과 튀르키예와의 긴장 지속이 이를 상쇄했다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में अधिकतर सामान्य समाचार रहे: पॉलिटेक्निक की वर्षगांठ के स्मरण कार्यक्रम, मेट्रो और मौसम संबंधी सूचनाएँ, तथा ग्रीस-साइप्रस केबल विवाद पर लगातार रिपोर्टिंग। सकारात्मक संकेतों में ग्रीक चेरी के लिए चीनी बाज़ार की पहुँच, 20 वर्षों के उच्चतम स्तर पर एथेंस स्टॉक एक्सचेंज की लिस्टिंग और सूचकांक में साप्ताहिक मामूली बढ़त शामिल हैं, जबकि दो दमकलकर्मियों की मौत और तुर्की के साथ जारी तनाव इनकी भरपाई करते हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως ρουτινική: εκδηλώσεις μνήμης για την επέτειο του Πολυτεχνείου, ανακοινώσεις για το μετρό και τον καιρό, και συνεχής ενημέρωση για τη διαμάχη γύρω από το καλώδιο Ελλάδας-Κύπρου. Tra i segnali positivi figurano l'accesso al mercato cinese per le ciliegie greche, quotazioni alla Borsa di Atene ai massimi da 20 anni e un modesto guadagno settimanale dell'indice, controbilanciati dalla morte di due vigili del fuoco e dalla persistente tensione con la Turchia.

summary.ja: 期間中は、エチオピアとエリトリアの国境での戦闘、ドローンや砲撃による攻撃、ティグレ反政府勢力の攻勢が主な報道を占め、また民兵による襲撃で8人が死亡した。国内経済ニュースは概ね日常的からポジティブで（投資契約、保険会社の好業績、電力輸出収入）、一方で治安状況と論調がスコアを押し下げている。
summary.ko: 이 기간의 주요 보도는 에티오피아와 에리트레아 국경 분쟁, 드론 및 포격 공격, 티그라이 반군의 공세가 차지했으며, 민병대 공격으로 8명이 사망했다. 국내 경제 뉴스는 일상적이거나 긍정적인 수준(투자 계약, 보험사의 견조한 이익, 전력 수출 수입)이지만, 치안 상황과 논조가 점수를 낮추고 있다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में इथियोपिया-एरिट्रिया सीमा पर संघर्ष, ड्रोन और तोपखाने के हमले, तथा टाइग्रे विद्रोही आक्रमण की खबरें हावी रहीं, और एक मिलिशिया हमले में 8 लोगों की मौत हुई। घरेलू आर्थिक समाचार नियमित से सकारात्मक रहे (निवेश सौदे, बीमा कंपनियों का मजबूत मुनाफा, बिजली निर्यात से राजस्व), लेकिन सुरक्षा स्थिति और लहजे के कारण स्कोर नीचे रहा।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από αναφορές για συγκρούσεις στα σύνορα Αιθιοπίας-Ερυθραίας, επιθέσεις με drones και πυροβολικό, καθώς και από επίθεση των ανταρτών του Τιγκράι, ενώ μια επίθεση πολιτοφυλακής σκότωσε 8 άτομα. Τα εγχώρια οικονομικά νέα είναι συνήθη έως θετικά (επενδυτικές συμφωνίες, ισχυρά κέρδη ασφαλιστικών εταιρειών, έσοδα από εξαγωγές ενέργειας), όμως η κατάσταση ασφάλειας και ο τόνος βαραίνουν τη βαθμολογία.
summary.tr: Dönem boyunca Etiyopya-Eritre sınır çatışmaları, insansız hava aracı ve topçu saldırıları ile Tigray isyancı saldırısı haberlerine hakimdir; ayrıca bir milis saldırısında 8 kişi hayatını kaybetmiştir. Ülke içi ekonomi haberleri rutin ila olumludur (yatırım anlaşmaları, güçlü sigorta şirketi kârları, elektrik ihracatı gelirleri), ancak güvenlik durumu ve tonu puanı aşağı çekmektedir.
summary.es: El periodo está dominado por informes de combates fronterizos entre Etiopía y Eritrea, ataques con drones y artillería, y una ofensiva de los rebeldes de Tigray, junto con un ataque de milicianos que dejó 8 muertos. Las noticias económicas nacionales son rutinarias o positivas (acuerdos de inversión, sólidos beneficios de aseguradoras, ingresos por exportación de electricidad), pero la situación de seguridad y el tono reducen la puntuación.
summary.fr: La période est dominée par les informations sur les combats à la frontière entre l'Éthiopie et l'Érythrée, les frappes de drones et d'artillerie, et une offensive des rebelles du Tigré, ainsi que par une attaque de milices ayant fait 8 morts. Les nouvelles économiques nationales sont courantes à positives (accords d'investissement, bénéfices solides des assureurs, recettes d'exportation d'électricité), mais la situation sécuritaire et le ton pèsent sur le score.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum wird von Meldungen über Grenzkämpfe zwischen Äthiopien und Eritrea, Drohnen- und Artillerieangriffe sowie eine Offensive der Tigray-Rebellen beherrscht, daneben ein Milizangriff mit acht Toten. Die inländischen Wirtschaftsnachrichten sind routinemäßig bis positiv (Investitionsabkommen, starke Gewinne von Versicherern, Einnahmen aus Stromexporten), doch die Sicherheitslage und der Tenor drücken den Wert nach unten.
summary.pt: O período é dominado por notícias de confrontos na fronteira entre Etiópia e Eritreia, ataques com drones e artilharia e uma ofensiva rebelde de Tigray, além de um ataque de milícias que deixou 8 mortos. As notícias econômicas nacionais são rotineiras a positivas (acordos de investimento, lucros fortes de seguradoras, receitas de exportação de energia elétrica), mas a situação de segurança e o tom pesam na pontuação.
summary.it: Le notizie sui combattimenti al confine tra Etiopia ed Eritrea, sugli attacchi con droni e artiglieria e su un'offensiva dei ribelli del Tigray dominano il periodo, insieme a un attacco di milizie che ha causato 8 morti. Le notizie economiche interne sono di routine o positive (accordi di investimento, utili solidi delle compagnie assicurative, ricavi dalle esportazioni di energia elettrica), ma la situazione di sicurezza e il tono abbassano il punteggio.
summary.ru: В этот период доминируют сообщения о пограничных боях между Эфиопией и Эритреей, ударах дронов и артиллерии, а также о наступлении повстанцев Тиграя; кроме того, нападение ополченцев унесло жизни 8 человек. Внутренние экономические новости в основном рутинные или позитивные (инвестиционные сделки, высокая прибыль страховых компаний, выручка от экспорта электроэнергии), однако ситуация в сфере безопасности и тон новостей снижают итоговую оценку.
summary.ar: تهيمن على الفترة تقارير عن اشتباكات على الحدود بين إثيوبيا وإريتريا، وضربات بالطائرات المسيّرة والمدفعية، وهجوم لمتمردي تيغراي، إضافة إلى هجوم شنته ميليشيا أودى بحياة 8 أشخاص. أما الأخبار الاقتصادية المحلية فهي روتينية إلى إيجابية (صفقات استثمارية، وأرباح قوية لشركات التأمين، وعائدات تصدير الكهرباء)، لكن الوضع الأمني ونبرة التغطية يخفضان التقييم العام.

summary.en: In Ecuador, heavy rains linked to El Niño caused floods and waterlogging in Guayaquil, the deaths of two workers in a landslide in Azuay, and the suspension of classes in five provinces; more than 1.3 million people are at risk. The country's risk rose to 535 points, and the electricity crisis is increasing diesel consumption. The death of a priest, though it generated news coverage, is insignificant for the country as a whole. Because no major disaster has occurred, the widespread effects of disasters and economic concerns keep the score below average.

summary.en: The period was dominated by heavy rain and flooding (437 adverse events, about 23,000 people affected, two landslide deaths), a power supply disruption from Colombia, and a fatal accident in which a priest was killed by a falling cross. summary.el: Η περίοδος αποτελείται κυρίως από συνηθισμένα αθλητικά και τοπικά νέα, με αρκετά αρνητικά θέματα: σύγκρουση αεροσκαφών στο αεροδρόμιο του Μαϊάμι, ακινητοποιημένες πτήσεις και διακοπή λειτουργίας της Microsoft, καθώς και η απώλεια από τις ΗΠΑ του καθεστώτος χωρίς ιλαρά, με αναφερόμενους 10 θανάτους. Jordanian exports to EU up 11.4%

summary.en: A deadly attack on a church in Karak, with several people killed, dominated coverage, and the King's throne speech responded with unity and security messaging. Parliament opened routinely with a new speaker, and GDELT tone is slightly above the world average, so the net score sits near a routine day weighed down by a serious security incident.

en: Deadly Karak church attack; the King vows to confront terrorism
Throne speech and parliament opening framed as institutional continuity
New parliament speaker elected; routine institutional transition

summary.en: Jordan's news over the period is mostly positive: an IMF staff-level deal on the sixth review that could unlock about $294 million, and a Jordanian judge re-elected to the International Court of Justice. The Karak church attack is handled through terrorism charges and a state security court referral, which is a routine institutional response rather than a crisis.

en: IMF staff-level deal on sixth review unlocking $294M
Jordanian judge re-elected to International Court of Justice
Karak church attack suspects charged and referred to trial

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: throne speech follow-up coverage, water policy debate, and cultural and diplomatic items. The IMF staff-level agreement unlocking $294m is a clear positive, offset by a condemned criminal attack in Karak and reports of divisions in parliamentary alliances.

en: IMF staff-level agreement on reviews, paving way for $294m
Salt museum registered on ALECSO heritage list
Condemned criminal act in Karak with reported casualties

summary.en: A deadly stabbing attack killed a security officer in Amman and was followed by condemnations and calls for national unity, with a Karak attack also referenced. Otherwise the period looks ordinary, with routine investment, social security and agricultural news, so the score sits somewhat below a typical day.

en: Terror stabbing attack killed a security officer in Amman
Widespread condemnations and public solidarity with the security services
Routine economic news: new factory investment and social security expansion

summary.en: A deadly stabbing attack in Amman killed a security officer, prompting overnight security raids and arrests, and the government vowed to continue the fight against terrorism. Coverage shows a unified public response and a commitment to tougher laws, but the incident is isolated and there is no wider unrest.

en: Deadly terrorist stabbing attack in Amman killed a security officer
Overnight security raids and arrests after the attack
Public unity and funeral gatherings; calls for tougher anti-terror laws

summary.en: The period is dominated by security concerns: a deadly attack that killed a security figure, a church incident, the foreign trial of recent security cases, and interceptions of weapons smuggling. Institutions remain functional, with a throne speech, a 2027 budget and investment diplomacy, so the picture is serious but not a crisis of state.

en: Deadly attack and mourning for a slain security figure (Salayta)
Weapons smuggling via balloons intercepted; extremism and border threats debated
Throne speech and 2027 budget signal routine institutional continuity

summary.en: The period is dominated by mourning after a deadly terrorist attack in Hamoud that killed nine people, followed by another death (Jawad Slayteh), and by the trial of the attackers. The state response is institutional: officials pledge unity against terrorism, and tougher counter-terrorism penalties are reported, which keeps the score in the serious-problems band rather than a crisis.

en: Deadly terrorist attack in Hamoud killing nine people and another man
Trial of church attack perpetrators proceeding through court sessions
Government and parliament pledge unity; tougher terrorism penalties cited

summary.en: The period was mostly routine: a 2027 budget of 13.7 billion dinars, 11 cooperation agreements signed with Syria, and tourism and industry dialogues. Security-related coverage of recent attacks and legal responses pulls the score only slightly above an ordinary day.

en: Jordan and Syria signed 11 cooperation memoranda and agreements
2027 budget of 13.7 billion dinars announced
Anti-terrorism legal amendments after recent Amman and Karak attacks

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: a date-palm festival, investment and trade announcements (Thailand trade up 35%), IAEA cooperation and a successful Asian rugby cup. A foiled terror attack honoured with a royal medal and regional-tension commentary add some security concern, but the tone is positive.

en: Trade with Thailand reported up 35% in anniversary year
Successful hosting of Asian rugby cup boosts sports standing
Officer honoured after repelling terror attack; security debate

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: domestic media focus on culture, education, the olive season, budget allocations, and investment forums, with GDELT tone unusually positive. Negatives include a deepening water crisis, a fatal police stabbing being prosecuted as terrorism, a minor 4.7 earthquake in Aqaba, and tensions after an earlier attack on Orthodox Christians.

en: Water crisis deepens as Israel supply deal expires
Policeman killed in stabbing; terrorism charges filed
Government funding for free school transport and rail network

summary.en: The period is mostly routine and leans positive: a Jordanian-European investment conference, Netherlands diplomatic anniversary, and efforts to lift a European aviation warning. Negatives include a friendly match moved out of Amman over security concerns and a foiled drug-smuggling attempt, which keep the score modest.

en: Jordan-European investment conference highlighted rail, ports and mining opportunities
Request to lift European aviation warning on Jordanian airspace
Australia-Jordan friendly moved from Amman over security worries

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: investment-conference promotion, sports achievements, and national commemorations, with GDELT tone well above the world average. Security concerns are present, including a reported terror attack on a church, a match moved to Qatar over security worries, and commentary on attacks in Amman and Karak, which keeps the score near neutral.

en: Reported terror attack on a church, mourned by Christians
Jordan-European investment conference promoted as regional draw
Football match relocated to Qatar over security concerns

summary.en: The period is dominated by a state security court sentencing three men to death over the October church attack in Karak that killed nine, a judicial resolution of a serious terror case. Otherwise coverage is routine: King Hussein commemorations, an EU-Jordan water and hydrogen investment conference, and tourism initiatives.
summary.ja: 今期は、10月にカラクで起きた教会襲撃事件(9人死亡)について、国家安全保障裁判所が男3人に死刑を言い渡したことが中心となっています。深刻なテロ事件に対する司法判断です。その他の報道は定例的なもので、フセイン国王の追悼行事、EUとヨルダンによる水と水素への投資会議、観光振興の取り組みなどが含まれます。
summary.ko: 이번 기간의 주요 소식은 국가보안법원이 10월 카라크 교회 공격(9명 사망)과 관련해 남성 3명에게 사형을 선고한 것입니다. 심각한 테러 사건에 대한 사법적 판결입니다. 그 밖의 보도는 일상적인 내용으로, 후세인 국왕 추모 행사, EU와 요르단의 물 및 수소 투자 회의, 관광 진흥 계획 등이 포함됩니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में मुख्य समाचार यह है कि राज्य सुरक्षा न्यायालय ने अक्टूबर में करक में चर्च पर हुए हमले, जिसमें नौ लोग मारे गए थे, के मामले में तीन पुरुषों को मौत की सज़ा सुनाई। यह एक गंभीर आतंकवादी मामले में न्यायिक निर्णय है। अन्य कवरेज सामान्य रहा, जिसमें किंग हुसैन के स्मरण आयोजन, यूरोपीय संघ-जॉर्डन जल और हाइड्रोजन निवेश सम्मेलन, और पर्यटन पहल शामिल हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από την καταδίκη τριών ανδρών σε θάνατο από το Δικαστήριο Κρατικής Ασφαλείας για την επίθεση στην εκκλησία στο Καράκ τον Οκτώβριο, που στοίχισε τη ζωή σε εννέα άτομα, μια δικαστική επίλυση μιας σοβαρής υπόθεσης τρομοκρατίας. Κατά τα άλλα, η κάλυψη είναι συνηθισμένη: εκδηλώσεις μνήμης για τον Βασιλιά Χουσεΐν, διάσκεψη επενδύσεων ΕΕ-Ιορδανίας για νερό και υδρογόνο και πρωτοβουλίες τουρισμού.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato dalla condanna a morte di tre uomini da parte di una corte di sicurezza dello Stato per l'attacco alla chiesa di Karak di ottobre, in cui sono morte nove persone: una risoluzione giudiziaria di un grave caso di terrorismo. Per il resto la copertura è di routine: commemorazioni del re Hussein, una conferenza sugli investimenti UE-Giordania in materia di acqua e idrogeno e iniziative turistiche.
summary.ru: В центре внимания за этот период — приговор государственного суда безопасности, назначившего смертную казнь трём мужчинам за октябрьское нападение на церковь в Караке, в результате которого погибли девять человек; это судебное решение по серьёзному делу о терроризме. В остальном освещение носит рутинный характер: памятные мероприятия в честь короля Хусейна, конференция ЕС и Иордании по инвестициям в водные ресурсы и водород и туристические инициативы.
summary.ar: تهيمن على هذه الفترة إدانة محكمة أمن الدولة ثلاثة رجال بالإعدام بسبب الهجوم على كنيسة الكرك في أكتوبر الذي أودى بحياة تسعة أشخاص، وهو حكم قضائي في قضية إرهاب خطيرة. أما بقية التغطية فروتينية: احتفالات تخليداً للملك حسين، ومؤتمر استثماري للاتحاد الأوروبي والأردن حول المياه والهيدروجين، ومبادرات سياحية.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر حکم اعدام سه مرد توسط دادگاه امنیت ملی در پرونده حمله اکتبر به کلیسای کرک است که نه کشته برجای گذاشت؛ حکمی قضایی در یک پرونده جدی تروریستی. جز آن، پوشش خبری روال عادی دارد: مراسم یادبود ملک حسین، کنفرانس سرمایه‌گذاری اتحادیه اروپا و اردن در زمینه آب و هیدروژن، و ابتکارات گردشگری.
summary.zh: 这一时期的焦点是国家安全法院对去年十月卡拉克教堂袭击案作出判决，三名男子被判处死刑，该袭击造成九人死亡，这是一起严重恐怖主义案件的司法裁决。除此之外，报道大多属于例行内容：纪念侯赛因国王的活动、欧盟与约旦关于水资源和氢能的投资会议，以及旅游推广举措。
summary.tr: Bu dönemde gündemi, Kerak'ta Ekim ayında yapılan ve dokuz kişinin hayatını kaybettiği kilise saldırısı nedeniyle üç erkeğin devlet güvenlik mahkemesi tarafından idama mahkum edilmesi hakimiyet kuruyor; bu, ciddi bir terör davasında yargısal bir karar niteliğinde. Diğer haberler olağan nitelikte: Kral Hüseyin anmaları, AB-Ürdün su ve hidrojen yatırım konferansı ve turizm girişimleri.
summary.es: El periodo está dominado por la condena a muerte, dictada por un tribunal de seguridad del Estado, de tres hombres por el atentado contra una iglesia en Karak en octubre, que dejó nueve muertos; una resolución judicial de un caso de terrorismo grave. Por lo demás, la cobertura es rutinaria: conmemoraciones del rey Hussein, una conferencia de inversión UE-Jordania sobre agua e hidrógeno y iniciativas turísticas.
summary.fr: La période est dominée par la condamnation à mort, prononcée par une cour de sûreté de l'État, de trois hommes pour l'attaque contre une église à Karak en octobre, qui a fait neuf morts, une décision judiciaire dans une affaire de terrorisme grave. Pour le reste, la couverture est de routine : commémorations du roi Hussein, conférence d'investissement UE-Jordanie sur l'eau et l'hydrogène, et initiatives touristiques.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum wird von der Verurteilung dreier Männer zum Tode durch ein staatliches Sicherheitsgericht beherrscht, und zwar wegen des Anschlags auf eine Kirche in Karak im Oktober, bei dem neun Menschen getötet wurden – eine gerichtliche Entscheidung in einem schweren Terrorfall. Ansonsten ist die Berichterstattung routinemäßig: Gedenkveranstaltungen für König Hussein, eine EU-Jordanien-Investitionskonferenz zu Wasser und Wasserstoff sowie Tourismusinitiativen.
summary.pt: O período é dominado pela condenação à morte, por um tribunal de segurança do Estado, de três homens pelo ataque a uma igreja em Karak, em outubro, que matou nove pessoas, uma decisão judicial num caso grave de terrorismo. No restante, a cobertura é rotineira: comemorações do rei Hussein, uma conferência de investimento UE-Jordânia sobre água e hidrogênio e iniciativas de turismo.

en: Three men sentenced to death over the Karak church attack
Investment conference offering water and green hydrogen opportunities
Routine commemorations and civic and cultural events dominate domestic media
ja: カラク教会襲撃事件で男3人に死刑判決
水および再生可能水素の機会を扱う投資会議
定例の追悼行事や市民・文化行事が国内報道の中心

물 및 녹색 수소 기회를 다룬 투자 회의
정례 추모 행사와 시민·문화 행사가 국내 언론을 주로 차지

it: Tre uomini condannati a morte per l'attacco alla chiesa di Karak
Conferenza sugli investimenti con opportunità nell'acqua e nell'idrogeno verde
Commemorazioni di routine ed eventi civici e culturali dominano i media nazionali

Инвестиционная конференция с возможностями в сфере воды и зелёного водорода

投资会议提供水资源和绿色氢能机遇

Conferencia de inversión que ofrece oportunidades en agua e hidrógeno verde
Las conmemoraciones rutinarias y los actos cívicos y culturales dominan los medios nacionales

Investitionskonferenz mit Chancen für Wasser und grünen Wasserstoff

Conferência de investimento com oportunidades em água e hidrogênio verde

summary.en: The country faces a very large Ebola outbreak (9,415 confirmed cases, over 4,500 deaths, spread to 8 provinces, spillover into neighboring Kenya). In addition, armed violence and displacement in the east (Djugu, Rutshuru), cholera-like diarrhoea deaths in North Kivu, the Kabila-led rebel movement and tensions with the government stand out. Payment problems for response teams, actions halting economic activity and protests further aggravate the situation; small positive developments such as school reopenings cannot offset it.

en: Ebola outbreak: 9,415 cases, ~4,500+ deaths, spread to an 8th province, unvaccinated strain
Armed violence and mass displacement in the east (Djugu 24,600; Rutshuru 70,000 without aid)
Kabila's rebel movement and political polarization/uncertainty over dialogue
Cholera-like diarrhoea outbreak in North Kivu and payment crisis for Ebola response staff
Miner protests in Kolwezi, 'Stop Ebola' day and shutdown in Beni, and tax-related reactions

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious problems: a spreading Ebola outbreak with a record caseload, fighting and health-system disruption in North Kivu, and an African Union warning against seizure of power by force amid a political and security crisis. Some positives, such as the National Assembly passing development financing, the school reopening in Inongo and the census going smoothly, do not offset these.

en: Ebola outbreak spreading, with more cases in North Kivu than Ituri
AU warns against seizure of power by force amid political crisis
Fighting in North Kivu leaves only 11 of 22 health zones working

summary.en: The DRC faces a severe Ebola outbreak nearing 10,000 cases with cross-border spread, renewed hostilities that have forced thousands to flee in the southeast, and a new rebel alliance. Local protests in Kolwezi are calming, but food prices are rising and political tensions are high.

en: Ebola outbreak rebounds, nearing 10,000 cases with cross-border spread
Thousands flee escalating hostilities in southeastern DRC
New rebel alliance and FDLR-related conflict coverage

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak nearing 10,000 DRC cases, ADF and CODECO massacres and hostage killings in the east, and a political rift between Tshisekedi and Kabila. Together these point to serious humanitarian and security strain, with no offsetting peace or recovery signal.

en: Ebola outbreak near 10,000 cases, spreading to Nigeria and health workers infected
77 civilians killed by ADF in Mambasa; over 80,000 displaced
Two hostages killed after CODECO abduction in Djugu

summary.en: The period is dominated by a fast-spreading Ebola outbreak, with deaths near 4,700 and cases in an eighth province, partly offset by the start of a vaccine trial. Domestic politics also show strain, including arrests of political figures and a no-confidence motion.

en: Ebola outbreak nearing 4,700 deaths and spreading to eighth province
Start of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine trial in Bunia
Arrests of opposition figure and UDPS cadre; no-confidence motion against minister

summary.en: The period mixes a major Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain), with Uganda restricting transit and Ebola response workers striking over unpaid bonuses, against a positive step in the launch of a vaccine trial. Political and security stress also shows up in more than 100 detentions in Lubumbashi, protests in Kisangani, and no-confidence motions in Tshuapa and Kinshasa.

en: Ebola outbreak spreading cross-border; Uganda restricts DRC-linked travellers
Launch of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine clinical trial in Bunia
Over 100 people detained in Lubumbashi security operations

summary.en: The period is dominated by an expanding Ebola outbreak, including a nurse killed over Ebola rumours and new Ugandan travel restrictions, alongside a constitutional referendum dispute and security-force violence against protesters and Catholic worshippers. Some positives, such as Ebola recoveries and FARDC operations against ADF, do not offset the serious problems.

en: Nurse killed in Bafwasende over Ebola rumours; health workers attacked
Uganda imposes travel restrictions and 21-day quarantine on DRC travellers
Security forces reportedly fire on Catholic faithful; Kolwezi unrest with 58 arrests

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak with attacks on health workers, including a nurse killed, and deadly CODECO attacks in Djugu that killed more than a dozen people. Political strain is also visible in a contested referendum law, a provincial governor's removal, and Kolwezi protests. Positive signals such as a vaccine trial, infrastructure launches and a youth peace festival do not offset these serious problems.

en: Ebola outbreak near 10,000 cases with attacks on health workers
CODECO attacks in Djugu killing more than a dozen people
Referendum law adoption and Senate opposition

summary.en: The period is dominated by an Ebola outbreak that passed 10,000 cases, with 1,424 deaths reported in North Kivu and a treatment centre overwhelmed, plus armed clashes in South Kivu and CODECO attacks in Djugu that killed more than a dozen people. Modest positives, such as recoveries, a solar plant inauguration and a vaccine trial, do not offset these serious problems.

en: Ebola outbreak passes 10,000 cases; 1,424 deaths in North Kivu
Treatment centre in Beni overwhelmed; nurse killed by mob
FARDC–FRN clashes in Fizi and Walungu; CODECO attacks in Djugu

summary.en: The period is dominated by a record Ebola outbreak (over 10,000 cases), renewed fighting around Uvira and Walikale with new displacements, and drone strikes linked to the Kabila-aligned FRN. Some positives, such as no new Ebola cases at Mongbwalu, rebel surrenders in Fizi and calm returning to Lodja, do not offset these serious problems.

en: Ebola outbreak surpasses 10,000 cases, concentrated in Ituri
Fighting around Uvira and renewed displacement in Walikale
Kabila-aligned FRN rebels and drone strike allegations

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak (over 10,000 cases, 4,900 deaths reported) and renewed fighting in the east that is displacing civilians and disrupting relief. Partial positives include a vaccine trial, a fighter surrender in Fizi, and US sanctions on Rwanda that Kinshasa welcomed, but they do not offset the crisis.

en: Ebola outbreak tops 10,000 confirmed cases and 4,900 deaths
Renewed fighting in Ituri and Walikale displaces thousands of civilians
464 human rights violations documented in July by BCNUDH

summary.en: The period is dominated by a severe Ebola epidemic in the east, with over 10,000 cases and a death toll near 5,000, alongside ongoing armed attacks, M23/FRN fighting and ADF activity. Positive news, such as exiting the FATF grey list, is outweighed by these serious humanitarian and security problems.

en: Ebola outbreak: over 2,300 new confirmed cases in three weeks
Eastern conflict: M23/FRN fighting near Uvira and renewed ADF presence
Removal from FATF grey list as a positive institutional signal

summary.en: The period is dominated by a severe Ebola epidemic (reported death toll above 5,000), a cholera outbreak in Mbandaka, active fighting in Masisi, and worsening hunger. Political tensions are also high, with a detained opposition figure denied bail and the president targeting Kabila allies.

en: Ebola death toll surpasses 5,000 in DR Congo
Cholera outbreak in Mbandaka: 14 deaths, 129 cases
Violent FARDC-FRN combat in Masisi

summary.en: An Ebola outbreak with over 5,000 deaths and 10,000 cases is spreading with no approved vaccine, alongside displacement, unaided humanitarian needs and killings in the east. Political tension over the Tshisekedi family case and arrests of a lawyer add to the strain, with only minor positives such as an airline lease and a promotional claim of eastern stability.

en: Ebola outbreak surpasses 5,000 deaths and 10,000 cases
Thousands of displaced people without humanitarian assistance in North Kivu
Hunger deepens for millions amid conflict and Ebola

summary.en: The period is dominated by a large Ebola outbreak reported at over 5,300 deaths, ongoing armed conflict in the east, and a projected hunger crisis affecting over 30 million people. Modest positives, such as the release of about 50 ADF ex-hostages and cautious hope around US sanctions, do not offset this humanitarian catastrophe.

en: Ebola outbreak reported at over 5,300 deaths
Projected hunger for over 30 million amid conflict and Ebola
Ongoing conflict with FRN/M23 and Rwanda tensions

summary.en: A large Ebola outbreak (over 10,000 cases, reportedly spreading), new ADF attacks forcing families to flee, and stalled peace talks with M23/FRN outweigh positives such as the exit from the FATF grey list. Overall the period reflects serious humanitarian and security strain rather than acute state collapse.

en: Ebola outbreak surpassing 10,000 cases and spreading in the east
ADF attack forcing hundreds of families to flee in Lubero
Fears of Doha process collapse over constitutional change

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious humanitarian and security problems: a cholera outbreak with about 1,800 deaths, an Ebola epidemic spreading to Beni, armed clashes killing civilians in Masisi, flooding, and severe malnutrition. Some positive items (WHO supplies, vaccine trials, community programmes) do not offset these crises.

en: Cholera outbreak reaching 60,000 cases and about 1,800 deaths
Ebola spreading, with Beni becoming the new epicentre in North Kivu
Civilians killed in FARDC-M23 clashes in Masisi

summary.en: Eastern DRC saw a deadly ADF attack that killed 10 civilians, ongoing fighting in Masisi and Uvira, and an active Ebola outbreak with an infected doctor evacuated. Some positives, such as FARDC retaking villages, new Ebola vaccine trials and a funded emergency health campaign, do not offset the serious security and health pressures.

en: ADF attack killed 10 civilians in eastern DR Congo
Ebola outbreak ongoing; infected doctor evacuated to London
Fighting in Masisi and Uvira; FARDC retook Mahanga and Kilongo

summary.en: The Ebola outbreak has passed 5,000 deaths and 10,000 cases, and an ADF massacre in Beni killed at least 33 civilians, while FARDC-FRN fighting intensifies in North Kivu. Modest positives, such as new vaccine trials and a US-DRC partnership meeting, do not offset the scale of the humanitarian and security crisis.

en: Ebola deaths rise to 5,198 with 10,668 cases
ADF attack in Beni kills at least 33 civilians
Intensified FARDC-FRN fighting on Kashebere-Kibati axis

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious problems: the Ebola outbreak is reported as the largest in the country's history, ADF attacks have forced suspected Ebola patients to flee, and 66 soldiers were sentenced to death. Ongoing states of siege and a nurses' strike add pressure, though WHO vaccine recommendations and a US-Congo minerals review offer some positive signals.

en: Ebola outbreak reported as largest in country's history
ADF attack causing Ebola patients to flee in Beni
66 military personnel sentenced to death in Goma

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious problems: a massacre in North Kivu, a new Ebola outbreak in the east, ADF attacks in Beni, flood damage in Gemena, and a military court sentencing 66 soldiers to death. Modest positives include the resumption of civil service pay and the reopening of the Kalamu bridge in Kinshasa.

en: Massacre at Cantine-Aloya and new Ebola outbreak in the east
ADF attack concerns and calls for coordinated military operations in Beni
Military court sentences 66 soldiers to death

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious problems: an Ebola outbreak nearing 11,000 cases with over 5,300 deaths, rebel advances, attacks on health facilities, kidnappings and inter-community violence. Some positives, such as a Mukamba reconciliation accord, joint FARDC-MONUSCO patrols and reopened health centres, are outweighed by the scale of the crisis.

en: Ebola outbreak nearing 11,000 cases, attacks on health structures
Rebels advancing and violence in Djugu and Ituri
Kidnappings on Rutshuru roads and armed attack on Kipushi school

summary.en: The period is dominated by a major Ebola outbreak (over 11,000 cases and more than 5,000 deaths, per foreign reports) alongside deadly armed attacks on civilians in the east and Ituri and cholera fears. Positives such as a Kasai peace pact, a trade agreement and Ebola recoveries do not offset the severity.

en: Ebola outbreak exceeds 11,000 cases with over 5,000 deaths
Armed attacks kill civilians in Masisi and Ituri camp
66 soldiers sentenced to death amid fighting in the east

summary.en: The 24-hour news flow is dominated by an ongoing Ebola outbreak with aid gaps, ADF massacres in the east, and a deepening food crisis. A referendum law signed amid third-term fears and the trial of an opposition figure add pressure on institutions, though FARDC gains in South Kivu offer a minor counterpoint.

en: ADF attacks killing civilians in Mambasa and elsewhere
Ebola outbreak with over 5,000 deaths and insecurity hampering response
Referendum law signed amid third-term concerns

summary.en: The DRC's last 24 hours are dominated by an uncontrolled Ebola outbreak (over 11,000 cases), ADF massacres in Mambasa and Beni, mass displacement of over 323,000 in South Kivu, and a cholera flare-up. Constitutional changes allowing a third term and new UN sanctions on the FRN add to pressure on institutions, though a few routine or minor positives (a football win, a new appointment) do not offset the severity.

en: Uncontrolled Ebola outbreak with over 11,000 cases
ADF attacks killing 35 civilians in Mambasa
Over 323,000 people displaced in Kalehe and Kabare

summary.en: Eastern DR Congo saw widespread armed violence: ADF attacks reportedly killed at least 49 civilians, FARDC and M23 accused each other of escalating fighting, and the Ebola outbreak and record hunger deepened. Modest positives, such as UNICEF noting progress in the Ebola response and efforts to formalise informal workers, do not offset the serious problems.

en: ADF attacks reportedly killed at least 49 civilians
Renewed FARDC-M23 fighting and civilian deaths in Kalehe
Ebola resurgence and record hunger projections

summary.en: The period is dominated by a historic Ebola epidemic (over 5,400 deaths, attacks on medics) alongside ADF and Mai-Mai violence in Ituri and a record hunger projection. Only minor positives, such as a new gold refinery, appear, so the score sits in the humanitarian-catastrophe band.
summary.tr: Dönem, Ebola salgınının tarihin en ölümcül olduğu ve 5.400'den fazla kişinin öldüğü, sağlık çalışanlarına saldırıların yaşandığı bir tablo tarafından belirleniyor. Bunun yanında Ituri'de ADF ve Mai-Mai şiddeti ile rekor düzeyde açlık öngörüsü öne çıkıyor. Yeni bir altın rafinerisi gibi yalnızca küçük olumlu gelişmeler var; bu nedenle puan insani felaket kategorisinde yer alıyor.
summary.es: El periodo está dominado por una epidemia histórica de ébola (más de 5.400 muertes y ataques contra personal sanitario), junto con la violencia de las ADF y los Mai-Mai en Ituri y una proyección récord de hambre. Solo aparecen avances menores, como una nueva refinería de oro, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa en el nivel de catástrofe humanitaria.
summary.fr: La période est dominée par une épidémie d'Ebola historique (plus de 5 400 décès, attaques contre le personnel médical), parallèlement aux violences des ADF et des Maï-Maï dans l'Ituri et à une projection record de faim. Seuls des points positifs mineurs, comme une nouvelle raffinerie d'or, apparaissent ; le score se situe donc dans la catégorie de la catastrophe humanitaire.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum wird von einer historischen Ebola-Epidemie (über 5.400 Todesfälle, Angriffe auf medizinisches Personal) sowie von Gewalt durch die ADF und die Mai-Mai in Ituri und einer Rekordprognose für Hunger geprägt. Es gibt nur geringfügige positive Entwicklungen, etwa eine neue Goldraffinerie; daher liegt die Bewertung im Bereich einer humanitären Katastrophe.
summary.pt: O período é dominado por uma epidemia histórica de Ebola (mais de 5.400 mortes e ataques a profissionais de saúde), somada à violência das ADF e dos Mai-Mai em Ituri e a uma projeção recorde de fome. Surgem apenas avanços menores, como uma nova refinaria de ouro, por isso a pontuação situa-se na faixa de catástrofe humanitária.
summary.ja: この期間は、歴史的なエボラ出血熱の流行(死者5,400人超、医療従事者への襲撃)が中心となっており、イトゥリ州でのADFおよびMai-Maiによる暴力と、過去最悪の飢餓予測も続いています。新たな金精製施設の開設など、わずかな前向きな動きはあるものの、スコアは人道的大惨事の水準にあります。
summary.ko: 이번 기간에는 역사적인 에볼라 유행(사망자 5,400명 이상, 의료진 공격)이 중심을 이루고 있으며, 이투리에서는 ADF와 마이마이의 폭력이 이어지고 있고 기아 전망치는 사상 최고 수준입니다. 새로운 금 정제 공장 가동 등 사소한 긍정적 소식도 있으나, 점수는 인도적 재앙 수준에 머물러 있습니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में एक ऐतिहासिक इबोला महामारी (5,400 से अधिक मौतें, चिकित्साकर्मियों पर हमले) प्रमुख है, साथ ही इटुरी में ADF और Mai-Mai की हिंसा और रिकॉर्ड स्तर की भूख का अनुमान भी है। एक नई सोना शोधन इकाई जैसे कुछ मामूली सकारात्मक बिंदु हैं, लेकिन स्कोर मानवीय आपदा के स्तर पर बना हुआ है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από μια ιστορική επιδημία Έμπολα (πάνω από 5.400 θάνατοι, επιθέσεις σε ιατρικό προσωπικό) παράλληλα με τη βία των ADF και των Mai-Mai στην Ιτούρι και μια ρεκόρ πρόβλεψη για την πείνα. Εμφανίζονται μόνο μικρές θετικές εξελίξεις, όπως ένα νέο εργοστάσιο εξευγενισμού χρυσού, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία παραμένει στη ζώνη της ανθρωπιστικής καταστροφής.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato da una storica epidemia di Ebola (oltre 5.400 morti, attacchi contro operatori sanitari), accanto alle violenze delle ADF e dei Mai-Mai in Ituri e a una proiezione record di fame. Compaiono solo modesti aspetti positivi, come una nuova raffineria d'oro, quindi il punteggio rientra nella fascia di catastrofe umanitaria.
summary.ru: Этот период определяется исторической эпидемией Эболы (более 5 400 погибших, нападения на медицинских работников) наряду с насилием ADF и Mai-Mai в Итури и рекордным прогнозом голода. Есть лишь незначительные позитивные факторы, например новый золотоперерабатывающий завод, поэтому оценка находится в диапазоне гуманитарной катастрофы.
summary.ar: تهيمن على هذه الفترة وباء إيبولا التاريخي (أكثر من 5400 حالة وفاة، وهجمات على العاملين في المجال الطبي)، إلى جانب عنف القوات الديمقراطية المتحالفة وميليشيات ماي ماي في إيتوري، وتوقعات قياسية بالجوع. لا تظهر سوى إيجابيات طفيفة، مثل مصفاة ذهب جديدة، لذا تقع النتيجة ضمن نطاق الكارثة الإنسانية.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر یک شیوع تاریخی ابولا (بیش از ۵۴۰۰ مرگ، حملات به کادر درمانی) و همچنین خشونت گروه‌های ADF و مای‌مای در ایتوری و پیش‌بینی رکوردی از گرسنگی قرار دارد. تنها نکات مثبت جزئی مانند یک پالایشگاه جدید طلا دیده می‌شود، از این رو امتیاز در محدوده فاجعه بشردوستانه قرار می‌گیرد.
summary.zh: 该时期主要受历史性埃博拉疫情（死亡人数超过5400人，医护人员遭袭）以及伊图里地区ADF和Mai-Mai武装的暴力活动影响，同时粮食危机预测创下纪录。仅有一些轻微的积极因素，如一座新金矿精炼厂，因此评分处于人道主义灾难区间。

en: Ebola outbreak, deadliest in history, spreading amid attacks on medics
ADF attacks in Ituri kill dozens and force civilians into labour
WHO projects record acute food insecurity from conflict and disease
tr: Tarihin en ölümcül Ebola salgını, sağlık çalışanlarına yönelik saldırılar sürerken yayılıyor
Ituri'de ADF saldırıları düzinelerce kişinin ölümüne yol açıyor ve sivilleri zorla çalıştırmaya itiyor
DSÖ, çatışma ve hastalıklara bağlı olarak rekor düzeyde akut gıda güvensizliği öngörüyor
es: Brote de ébola, el más mortífero de la historia, que se extiende en medio de ataques contra personal sanitario
Los ataques de las ADF en Ituri matan a decenas de personas y obligan a los civiles a realizar trabajos forzados
La OMS proyecta niveles récord de inseguridad alimentaria aguda por el conflicto y las enfermedades
fr: Épidémie d'Ebola, la plus meurtrière de l'histoire, qui se propage au milieu d'attaques contre le personnel médical
Les attaques des ADF en Ituri tuent des dizaines de personnes et contraignent des civils au travail forcé
L'OMS prévoit un niveau record d'insécurité alimentaire aiguë liée au conflit et aux maladies
de: Ebola-Ausbruch, der tödlichste der Geschichte, breitet sich aus, während medizinisches Personal angegriffen wird
ADF-Angriffe in Ituri töten Dutzende Menschen und zwingen Zivilisten zu Zwangsarbeit
Die WHO prognostiziert eine Rekordzahl akuter Ernährungsunsicherheit infolge von Konflikt und Krankheiten
pt: Surto de Ebola, o mais mortal da história, espalha-se em meio a ataques a profissionais de saúde

A OMS projeta níveis recordes de insegurança alimentar aguda decorrentes do conflito e de doenças

WHO는 분쟁과 질병으로 인한 급성 식량 불안이 기록적 수준에 이를 것으로 전망함
hi: इतिहास का सबसे घातक इबोला प्रकोप, चिकित्साकर्मियों पर हमलों के बीच फैल रहा है

L'OMS prevede un'insicurezza alimentare acuta record causata dal conflitto e dalle malattie

summary.en: In Guinea over the last 24 hours there is a routine agenda: preparations for the Senate election, water and road infrastructure projects, a new state tobacco company, the start of the university term, and a corruption case. The Simandou iron ore project reaching a production rate of about 10 Mtpa is economically positive, while the fatal passenger accident at Séguéya is negative but local in scale. Since there is no clear crisis or major improvement, the score is near neutral, slightly positive.

en: Simandou iron ore production reaching a rate of about 10 Mtpa
Announcement of candidate bonds and campaign spending limits for the Senate elections
Announcement of water (600 million euros) and road infrastructure projects
Passenger accident at Séguéya resulting in 2 dead and 34 injured
Waiting time at the Port of Conakry falling to 15 days, with additional costs continuing

summary.en: The period mixes positive investment news (a $2bn UK Export Finance envelope and £330m in contracts) and a youth-participation initiative with routine judicial cases, a municipal wage-arrears strike threat and a magnitude 6.9 offshore earthquake that the headlines show only as a government response plan. On balance this is an ordinary day with a slight positive lean.

en: UK Export Finance $2bn and £330m investment announcements
Magnitude 6.9 offshore earthquake near Conakry, government prevention plan
Municipal wage arrears and threatened indefinite strike in Dixinn

summary.en: The period was mostly routine governance and economic news: judicial appointments, e-signature and public-finance reforms, and upbeat Simandou revenue and UK investment figures. The main negative item was a former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years, and GDELT tone is somewhat more negative than the world average.

en: Simandou revenue projections rising to $2.5 billion by 2040
UK investment ambition lifted above $3 billion
Former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years

summary.en: The period is mostly routine administration: a 4,500-post health recruitment, validation of a public finance reform plan, and Simandou diplomacy. The main negative item is the seven-year sentence of a former Constitutional Court president, alongside a security crackdown in Conakry, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years in prison
Conakry crackdown on crime and drug networks launched by prosecutor
Validation of 2026-2030 public finance reform strategy

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: infrastructure approvals, a health recruitment drive, China partnership pledges and a strong run by the U18 team at the world school championship. Offsetting this are a jailing of a former Constitutional Court president and a union dispute, and GDELT tone (-0.33) is less negative than the world average.

en: Guinea U18 team advances at the world school championship
Labé–Tougué road and Kankan–Kissidougou works advance
Former Constitutional Court president sentenced to seven years

summary.en: A mostly routine day in Guinea: the revised 2026 budget shows GDP decline and rising inflation amid an oil crisis, but a state bond issue was heavily oversubscribed and a road loan was ratified. Security operations and union wage demands are ordinary news, and GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Oversubscribed state bond raising 4,579 billion GNF
Revised 2026 budget shows GDP decline and higher inflation
Road loan for Labé-Tougué highway ratified

summary.en: The period was routine and mildly positive, dominated by youth football results (a U20 qualification for the CAN, a U18 World Cup final loss, and a U15 win) and a Horoya CAF qualification. Fuel prices were held at 12,000 GNF and new administrative units were created, with no sign of a political or security crisis.

en: U20 team qualifies for CAN 2027 final
Fuel price maintained at 12,000 GNF
Timbo and Wanindara administrative upgrades announced

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: Guinea signed the Accra Convention on trade and SME credit, and a 2026 growth forecast of 8.6% was reported alongside Simandou progress. Offsetting this, a former Constitutional Court president was sentenced to seven years, and a journalist died, which keeps the score only modestly above an ordinary day.

en: Signing of Accra Convention on trade and SME credit access
Reported 8.6% growth forecast for 2026 and Simandou push
Sentencing of former Constitutional Court president by CRIEF

summary.en: A largely routine day in Guinea: the state raised about 4,500 billion GNF on the local bank market and a $517 million bond, and new budget rules were validated. Negatives are minor, including contract teachers protesting exclusion from recruitment and complaints about the Kankan–Kissidougou road, and the GDELT tone (-0.10) is better than the world average.

en: State raised about 4,500 billion GNF on local banking market
$517 million state bond issuance mobilised
Public expenditure nomenclature and local accounting plan validated

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: a successful 4,579 billion GNF bond issuance, Proparco financing for Soguipal, new ministerial and judicial appointments, and Simandou and China investment news. Negatives are limited to anger in Faranah over a student's death and job cuts at Bel Air Mining, so the score sits modestly above an ordinary day.

en: State mobilised 4,579 billion GNF through its 2026 bond issue
Proparco's 5 million euro financing for Soguipal expansion
Anger in Faranah after a student's death, with hospital explanations

summary.en: Guinea's news over the period is mostly routine but leans positive, led by a government bond raise of 4,579 billion GNF (nearly double the target) and a $520 million local financing. Mining (Simandou), a UN visit and stadium homologation add to the stable picture, offset only by a military dismissals decree and a media-minister story.

en: Bond issue of 4,579 billion GNF, nearly double target
$520 million raised on local financial market
Simandou mining operations and Rio Tinto SimFer coverage

summary.en: Routine news dominated the period: a domestic bond issuance, a sports title, a hotel deal, and Simandou mining coverage, with GDELT tone (-0.10) well above the world average. Negatives were local (power shortages, administrative suspensions in Siguiri, student housing complaints), and no crisis or crackdown appears in the headlines.

en: Simandou mining coverage and a hotel development deal signed in Conakry
UFOA U20 football title and U18 school team's return from the world championship
Administrative suspensions in Siguiri and power shortages affecting communities

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with a few positive signals: the parliament adopted the 2026 revised budget law, and a government bond raised 4,579 billion GNF, well above target. Offsetting concerns include about 3.39 billion USD of external-financed projects reported as blocked, and complaints from contract workers and villages lacking water.

en: Government bond raised 4,579 billion GNF, exceeding initial target
Parliament adopted the revised 2026 budget law
About 3.39 billion USD of external-financed projects reported blocked

summary.en: The period was mostly upbeat: the inauguration of the country's first gold refinery, a record bond issue, and new investment partnerships, alongside routine army anniversary events. Negatives were local and limited, including a water shortage protest in Kérouané and errors in a school digital system.

en: Inauguration of Nimba Gold Refinery, the country's first gold refinery
Record bond issue in Guinean francs and new Samsung investment partnership
Local water shortage protest and school digital system errors

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: the inauguration of a first gold refinery and urban-rehabilitation projects are positive, while the central bank's warnings on liquidity and cash shortages and the army deployment against illegal gold mining in Siguiri weigh against them. GDELT tone is above the world average, so the overall picture is slightly positive.

en: First gold refinery inaugurated in Conakry, reported by multiple outlets
Central bank warns of liquidity crisis and banknote shortage
State deploys army against anarchic gold mining in Siguiri

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and development news with serious concerns: mass dismissals of local officials over illegal gold mining in Siguiri, a detained former official's unclear fate, and an alleged abduction ending in death. Positive items, including a new gold refinery and a regional diplomatic appointment, and a tone more negative than the world average keep the score just below neutral.

en: Mass dismissals of 479 local officials and 22 administrators over illegal gold mining
Alleged abduction and death of Boubacar Barry; detained ex-OGP head's health and fate
Proposed anti-terrorism bill raising concerns about civil liberties

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine anti-corruption prosecutions and administrative dismissals over illegal gold mining, alongside a state gold refinery inauguration and a regional vote scheduled for 29 November. Negatives include slowing growth, rising inflation, mass departures of foreign miners after the mining ban, and an unpaid $29bn arbitration claim.

en: Mass departure of foreign miners after illegal gold mining ban
Growth slowing and inflation rising, per government explanations

Η αντιπολίτευση καταγγέλλει αυταρχική παρέκκλιση, οργανώσεις ανθρωπίνων δικαιωμάτων ζητούν ανεξάρτητες έρευνες και οικογένειες εγκαταλείπουν τις εστίες τους. Οι θετικές επενδυτικές ειδήσεις από τη σύνοδο του Simandou δεν αντισταθμίζουν τη σοβαρή βία και τον εκτοπισμό.
summary.it: Scontri mortali tra forze di sicurezza e minatori d'oro a Siguiri e Balato hanno causato almeno 10 morti dopo un divieto sull'attività mineraria; l'opposizione denuncia una deriva autoritaria, le organizzazioni per i diritti umani chiedono indagini e le famiglie stanno fuggendo. Le notizie positive sugli investimenti emerse dal vertice di Simandou non attenuano la gravità della violenza e degli sfollamenti.
summary.ru: Смертельные столкновения между силами безопасности и золотодобытчиками в Сигири и Балато унесли жизни как минимум 10 человек после введения запрета на добычу. Оппозиция обвиняет власти в сползании к авторитаризму, правозащитные организации требуют расследования, семьи бегут из региона. Позитивные инвестиционные новости с саммита по Симанду не компенсируют серьёзного насилия и перемещения населения.
summary.ar: أسفرت اشتباكات دامية بين قوات الأمن وعمال مناجم الذهب في سيغيري وبالاتو عن مقتل 10 أشخاص على الأقل بعد حظر التعدين، بينما تندد المعارضة بانزلاق نحو الاستبداد، وتطالب منظمات حقوقية بإجراء تحقيقات، وتفر العائلات من المنطقة. ولا تعوض الأخبار الإيجابية عن الاستثمار من قمة سيماندو العنف الخطير والنزوح.

summary.tr: Siguiri ve Balato'da güvenlik güçleri ile altın madencileri arasında, bir madencilik yasağının ardından yaşanan ölümcül çatışmalarda en az 10 kişi hayatını kaybetti. Muhalefet otoriter bir eğilim olduğunu öne sürerken, insan hakları örgütleri bağımsız soruşturma talep ediyor ve aileler bölgeden kaçıyor. Simandou zirvesinden gelen olumlu yatırım haberleri, ciddi şiddet ve yerinden edilme olgusunu telafi etmiyor.
summary.es: Los enfrentamientos mortales entre las fuerzas de seguridad y los mineros de oro en Siguiri y Balato dejaron al menos 10 muertos tras una prohibición de la minería. La oposición denuncia una deriva autoritaria, las organizaciones de derechos humanos exigen investigaciones y las familias huyen. Las noticias positivas sobre inversiones de la cumbre de Simandou no compensan la grave violencia y el desplazamiento.

Les annonces positives d'investissements issues du sommet de Simandou ne compensent pas la gravité des violences et des déplacements.

summary.pt: O período é, em grande parte, de rotina: as receitas do turismo ultrapassaram 7 mil milhões de dinares, as exportações de azeite estão a crescer e decorrem eventos culturais e institucionais. Em contraponto, a Amnistia Internacional pede um inquérito independente sobre 12 mortes documentadas em prisões, num contexto de sobrelotação superior a 194%, e há pressão parlamentar sobre a reforma do código monetário.
summary.ja: 期間は概ね平常通りである。観光収入は7 billion ディナールを超え、オリーブオイルの輸出は拡大しており、文化・制度関連の行事も続いている。一方で、アムネスティは収容率194%の過密状態の中で記録された囚人12人の死亡について独立した調査を求めており、また通貨コード改革をめぐって議会が圧力をかけている。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 흐름이다. 관광 수입은 7 billion 디나르를 넘었고, 올리브유 수출은 확대되고 있으며, 문화 및 제도 관련 행사도 계속되고 있다. 반면, 앰네스티는 수용률 194%를 넘는 과밀 상황에서 기록된 교도소 사망 12건에 대해 독립적인 조사를 요구했고, 통화 코드 개혁을 둘러싸고 의회의 압박도 이어지고 있다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में अधिकतर सामान्य गतिविधियाँ रहीं: पर्यटन राजस्व 7 billion dinars से आगे निकल गया, जैतून तेल का निर्यात बढ़ रहा है, और सांस्कृतिक एवं संस्थागत कार्यक्रम जारी हैं। इसके विपरीत, एमनेस्टी ने 194% से अधिक भीड़भाड़ के बीच जेल में दर्ज 12 मौतों की स्वतंत्र जांच की मांग की है, और मुद्रा कोड सुधार पर संसद का दबाव बना हुआ है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως συνηθισμένη: τα έσοδα από τον τουρισμό ξεπέρασαν τα 7 billion dinars, οι εξαγωγές ελαιολάδου επεκτείνονται και πολιτιστικές και θεσμικές εκδηλώσεις συνεχίζονται. Αντίστροφα, η Διεθνής Αμνηστία ζητά ανεξάρτητη έρευνα για 12 καταγεγραμμένους θανάτους σε φυλακές, με υπερπληρότητα άνω του 194%, ενώ υπάρχει κοινοβουλευτική πίεση για τη μεταρρύθμιση των κωδικών νομίσματος.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: i ricavi del turismo hanno superato i 7 miliardi di dinari, le esportazioni di olio d'oliva sono in crescita e sono in corso eventi culturali e istituzionali. A controbilanciare il quadro ci sono l'appello di Amnesty International per un'indagine indipendente su 12 decessi documentati in carcere, con un sovraffollamento superiore al 194%, e le pressioni parlamentari sulla riforma dei codici valutari.
summary.ru: Период в целом рутинный: доходы от туризма превысили 7 миллиардов динаров, экспорт оливкового масла расширяется, продолжаются культурные и институциональные мероприятия. Уравновешивают картину призыв Amnesty International к независимому расследованию 12 задокументированных смертей в тюрьмах при переполненности свыше 194% и парламентское давление в связи с реформой валютных кодов.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: تجاوزت إيرادات السياحة 7 مليارات دينار، وتتوسع صادرات زيت الزيتون، وتتواصل الفعاليات الثقافية والمؤسسية. في المقابل، دعت منظمة العفو الدولية إلى إجراء تحقيق مستقل في 12 حالة وفاة موثقة في السجون، في ظل اكتظاظ يتجاوز 194%، كما تمارس ضغوط برلمانية بشأن إصلاح الرموز النقدية.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً روال‌مانده است: درآمد گردشگری از ۷ میلیارد دینار گذشته، صادرات روغن زیتون در حال گسترش است و رویدادهای فرهنگی و نهادی ادامه دارد. در مقابل، عفو بین‌الملل خواستار تحقیق مستقل درباره 12 مرگ مستندشده در زندان‌ها شده است، در حالی که ازدحام زندان‌ها از 194% فراتر رفته است، و فشار پارلمانی بر اصلاح کدهای ارزی نیز ادامه دارد.
summary.zh: 本期总体属于常规情况：旅游收入已超过70亿第纳尔，橄榄油出口持续扩大，文化和机构活动正在进行。与之相抵的是，国际特赦组织呼吁对12起有记录的监狱死亡事件展开独立调查，监狱人满率超过194%；同时，议会就货币代码改革向央行施压。

summary.el: Η περίοδος του Κατάρ είναι κυρίως συνηθισμένη: εκπαίδευση, ψηφιακή οικονομία, επισιτιστική ασφάλεια και αθλητισμός, με θετικό εσωτερικό τόνο. Η κύρια εξέλιξη είναι το αμυντικό σύμφωνο αμοιβαίας άμυνας Κατάρ-Τουρκίας που υπογράφηκε στις 14 Νοεμβρίου, στο πλαίσιο του πολέμου ΗΠΑ-Ιράν, το οποίο είναι μια αξιόλογη συμφωνία αλλά φέρει περιφερειακό κίνδυνο. Μια δικαστική υπόθεση στο Λονδίνο με ισχυρισμούς για χρηματοδότηση της τρομοκρατίας προσθέτει αρνητική κάλυψη από το εξωτερικό.
summary.tr: Katar'ın dönemi büyük ölçüde rutin gelişmelerden oluşuyor: eğitim, dijital ekonomi, gıda güvenliği ve spor. İç kamuoyundaki ton olumlu. Başlıca gelişme, ABD-İran savaşının gölgesinde 14 Kasım'da imzalanan Katar-Türkiye karşılıklı savunma anlaşması. Bu dikkat çekici bir anlaşma, ancak bölgesel riskler taşıyor. Londra'da terör finansmanı iddiasıyla açılan bir dava ise yabancı basında olumsuz haberlere yol açıyor.
summary.es: El período de Catar es en gran medida rutinario: educación, economía digital, seguridad alimentaria y deportes, con un tono positivo en el ámbito interno. El principal acontecimiento es un pacto de defensa mutua entre Catar y Turquía firmado el 14 de noviembre, en el contexto de la guerra entre EE. UU. e Irán. Es un acuerdo notable, pero conlleva riesgos regionales. Una causa judicial en Londres que alega financiación del terrorismo añade cobertura internacional negativa.
summary.fr: La période du Qatar est en grande partie routinière : éducation, économie numérique, sécurité alimentaire et sport, avec un ton positif sur le plan intérieur. Le fait marquant est un pacte de défense mutuelle entre le Qatar et la Turquie, signé le 14 novembre, dans le contexte de la guerre opposant les États-Unis à l'Iran. C'est un accord notable, mais qui comporte des risques régionaux. Une affaire judiciaire à Londres, qui allègue un financement du terrorisme, ajoute une couverture négative à l'étranger.
summary.de: Die Phase Katars verläuft größtenteils routinemäßig: Bildung, digitale Wirtschaft, Ernährungssicherheit und Sport, mit einem positiven Tenor im Inland. Die wichtigste Entwicklung ist ein am 14. November unterzeichneter gegenseitiger Verteidigungspakt zwischen Katar und der Türkei vor dem Hintergrund des Krieges zwischen den USA und dem Iran. Es handelt sich um eine bemerkenswerte Vereinbarung, die jedoch regionale Risiken birgt. Ein Gerichtsverfahren in London, in dem der Vorwurf der Terrorfinanzierung erhoben wird, sorgt für negative Berichterstattung im Ausland.
summary.pt: O período do Catar é, em grande parte, rotineiro: educação, economia digital, segurança alimentar e desporto, com um tom positivo no plano interno. O principal desenvolvimento é um pacto de defesa mútua entre o Catar e a Turquia, assinado a 14 de novembro, num contexto de guerra entre os EUA e o Irão. É um acordo notável, mas acarreta riscos regionais. Um processo judicial em Londres que alega financiamento do terrorismo acrescenta cobertura negativa na imprensa estrangeira.
summary.it: Il periodo del Qatar è per lo più di routine: istruzione, economia digitale, sicurezza alimentare e sport, con un tono interno positivo. Lo sviluppo principale è il patto di difesa reciproca Qatar-Turchia firmato il 14 novembre, nel contesto della guerra tra Stati Uniti e Iran. Si tratta di un accordo rilevante, ma comporta rischi regionali, e un processo presso un tribunale di Londra che accusa il Qatar di finanziamento del terrorismo aggiunge una copertura estera negativa.
summary.ru: Период Катара в основном рутинный: образование, цифровая экономика, продовольственная безопасность и спорт, с позитивным внутренним фоном. Главное событие — подписанный 14 ноября договор о взаимной обороне между Катаром и Турцией на фоне войны США и Ирана. Это заметное соглашение, однако оно несёт региональные риски, а судебное дело в Лондоне, в котором утверждается о финансировании терроризма, добавляет негативных сообщений в зарубежных СМИ.
summary.ar: تتسم الفترة في قطر في معظمها بالطابع الروتيني: التعليم والاقتصاد الرقمي والأمن الغذائي والرياضة، مع نبرة داخلية إيجابية. أبرز التطورات هو توقيع اتفاقية الدفاع المشترك بين قطر وتركيا في 14 نوفمبر، في ظل خلفية الحرب بين الولايات المتحدة وإيران. وهي اتفاقية ملحوظة لكنها تحمل مخاطر إقليمية، وتضيف قضية في محكمة لندن تزعم تمويل الإرهاب تغطية خارجية سلبية.
summary.fa: دوره قطر عمدتاً عادی است: آموزش، اقتصاد دیجیتال، امنیت غذایی و ورزش، با لحنی مثبت در داخل کشور. مهم‌ترین تحول، پیمان دفاع متقابل قطر و ترکیه است که در 14 نوامبر امضا شد و در پس‌زمینه جنگ آمریکا و ایران قرار دارد. این توافق قابل توجه است اما خطرات منطقه‌ای به همراه دارد، و پرونده‌ای در دادگاه لندن با ادعای تأمین مالی تروریسم، پوشش منفی خارجی را افزایش می‌دهد.

La cobertura extranjera es mayormente deportiva y de temas económicos menores, y el tono positivo de GDELT se compensa con que los medios nacionales son unilaterales, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa moderadamente por encima de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La période est routinière : les médias nationaux rapportent l'ouverture d'infrastructures, une hausse du transport de marchandises et de voyageurs, et les préparatifs de l'approvisionnement énergétique pour l'hiver, ainsi que la couverture de la Journée du Président. La couverture étrangère concerne surtout le sport et des sujets économiques mineurs, et le ton positif de GDELT est atténué par le caractère unilatéral des médias nationaux, si bien que le score se situe modérément au-dessus d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft routinemäßig: Inlandsmedien berichten über Infrastruktureröffnungen, einen Anstieg des Güter- und Personenverkehrs sowie Vorbereitungen auf die Energieversorgung im Winter, daneben über den Tag des Präsidenten. Die ausländische Berichterstattung betrifft überwiegend Sport und kleinere Wirtschaftsthemen; der positive GDELT-Tonwert wird dadurch relativiert, dass die inländischen Medien einseitig berichten, sodass der Wert leicht über einem gewöhnlichen Tag liegt.
summary.pt: O período é rotineiro: a mídia doméstica relata inaugurações de infraestrutura, aumento no transporte de carga e passageiros e preparativos para o abastecimento de energia no inverno, além da cobertura do Dia do Presidente. A cobertura estrangeira é em sua maioria esportiva e de itens econômicos menores, e o tom positivo do GDELT é compensado pelo fato de a mídia doméstica ser unilateral, de modo que a pontuação fica moderadamente acima de um dia comum.
summary.ja: この期間は平常どおりである。国内メディアはインフラの開業、貨物および旅客輸送の増加、冬季のエネルギー供給に向けた準備を報じており、大統領の日の報道も含まれている。海外での報道は主にスポーツと小規模な経済ニュースであり、GDELTのポジティブなトーンは、国内メディアの一方的な報道によって相殺されているため、スコアは通常の一日よりわずかに高い水準にとどまっている。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 평이한 수준이다. 국내 언론은 인프라 개통, 화물 및 여객 수송 증가, 겨울철 에너지 공급 준비를 보도했으며, 대통령의 날 관련 보도도 함께 이어졌다. 해외 보도는 주로 스포츠와 사소한 경제 소식이다. GDELT의 긍정적 어조는 국내 언론의 일방적 보도로 상쇄되어, 점수는 평범한 하루보다 다소 높은 수준에 머물러 있다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि सामान्य है। घरेलू मीडिया में बुनियादी ढांचे के उद्घाटन, माल और यात्री परिवहन में वृद्धि, तथा सर्दियों की ऊर्जा आपूर्ति की तैयारियों की रिपोर्टें आई हैं, साथ ही राष्ट्रपति दिवस का कवरेज भी है। विदेशी कवरेज मुख्यतः खेल और छोटे आर्थिक समाचारों तक सीमित है, और GDELT का सकारात्मक स्वर घरेलू मीडिया के एकतरफ़ा होने से संतुलित हो जाता है, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से थोड़ा ऊपर रहता है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι συνηθισμένη: τα εγχώρια μέσα ενημέρωσης αναφέρουν εγκαινιάσεις υποδομών, αύξηση των μεταφορών εμπορευμάτων και επιβατών, και προετοιμασίες για την ενεργειακή τροφοδοσία του χειμώνα, παράλληλα με την κάλυψη της Ημέρας του Προέδρου. Η ξένη κάλυψη αφορά κυρίως τον αθλητισμό και δευτερεύοντα οικονομικά θέματα, και ο θετικός τόνος του GDELT εξουδετερώνεται από το γεγονός ότι τα εγχώρια μέσα είναι μονομερή, γι' αυτό και η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται μετρίως πάνω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.
summary.it: Il periodo è di routine: i media nazionali riportano l'apertura di infrastrutture, un aumento del trasporto merci e passeggeri e i preparativi per l'approvvigionamento energetico invernale, oltre alla copertura della Giornata del Presidente. La copertura estera riguarda per lo più lo sport e voci economiche minori, e il tono positivo di GDELT è compensato dal fatto che i media nazionali sono unilaterali, quindi il punteggio si colloca moderatamente al di sopra di una giornata ordinaria.
summary.ru: Период носит рутинный характер: национальные СМИ сообщают об открытии инфраструктурных объектов, росте объёмов грузовых и пассажирских перевозок и подготовке к зимнему энергоснабжению, а также об освещении Дня президента. Зарубежное освещение в основном касается спорта и мелких экономических новостей, а позитивная тональность GDELT компенсируется односторонностью национальных СМИ, поэтому оценка лишь умеренно выше обычного дня.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية: تنقل وسائل الإعلام المحلية افتتاح منشآت البنية التحتية، وارتفاع حجم نقل البضائع والركاب، والاستعدادات لإمدادات الطاقة الشتوية، إلى جانب تغطية يوم الرئيس. تتركز التغطية الخارجية غالباً على الرياضة وبعض البنود الاقتصادية الصغيرة، ويُعادل النغمة الإيجابية في GDELT كون وسائل الإعلام المحلية أحادية الجانب، لذا تقع الدرجة أعلى قليلاً من يوم عادي.
summary.fa: این دوره عادی است: رسانه‌های داخلی از افتتاح زیرساخت‌ها، افزایش حمل‌ونقل بار و مسافر، و آماده‌سازی تأمین انرژی زمستانی، و همچنین پوشش روز رئیس‌جمهور گزارش می‌دهند. پوشش خارجی بیشتر شامل ورزش و اخبار کوچک اقتصادی است، و لحن مثبت GDELT با یک‌جانبه بودن رسانه‌های داخلی متعادل می‌شود، بنابراین امتیاز اندکی بالاتر از یک روز معمولی است.

summary.en: Zambia is showing a normal period: news on investment and cooperation in mining, tourism and energy stands out. Negative news, such as bail hearings for opposition leaders, a vaccination campaign against a cholera outbreak and a bus accident, has a balancing effect. There is no clear crisis or extraordinary positive development.

en: Investment and cooperation news in mining, energy and tourism
Trials and bail hearings of opposition leaders
Oral vaccination campaign against a cholera outbreak
Regional (Great Lakes) security diplomacy
Bus accident and ritual murder reports

summary.en: The period is mostly routine to mildly positive, with cooperation deals (IAEA nuclear, Chinese investment, tourism plan) and regional diplomacy dominating coverage. Offsetting this are the ongoing bail proceedings against opposition leader Mundubile and his co-accused, a police shooting, and a child lead-poisoning case.

en: IAEA nuclear cooperation pledge and Chinese investment for industrialization
Ongoing bail hearings for opposition figures, with a lawyer alleging mistreatment
Plan to double tourism and regional energy and mining diplomacy

summary.en: The period is mostly positive: Zambia passed a 1 GW solar milestone, First Quantum's Kansanshi expansion is on track to beat its target, and Zambia and Malawi completed a prisoner swap. Regional diplomacy (COMESA summit) and investment news add to this, while the lead-poisoning story of children is a notable negative. GDELT tone is also clearly positive.

en: Zambia surpasses 1 GW solar milestone
First Quantum Kansanshi expansion beats design capacity
Zambia and Malawi swap 25 prisoners

summary.en: The period looks routine, with mixed news: a repeated mining-linked pollution concern on the Kafue River and a fatal rat-bite case, offset by investment, diplomacy and institutional items such as the COMESA headquarters title deed. GDELT tone is positive, but the headline set does not show a clear crisis or a clear breakthrough.

en: Repeated mining pollution reports affecting the Kafue River
COMESA headquarters title deed secured
Nomba expands B2B payments into Zambia

summary.en: Zambia's period shows solid economic news: 5.2% growth in 2025, a $122m copper deal, and a COMESA headquarters land handover. Offsetting this, Independence Day coverage notes rising political tensions and a DW piece questions whether the country is sliding into autocracy, so the score sits modestly above an ordinary day.

en: Economy grew 5.2% in 2025, though a $5.4bn financing gap remains
ZDA-Rongxing $122m copper deal signed
Reports of rising political tensions and autocracy concerns

summary.en: The period was mostly routine: Independence Day greetings, a COMESA trade piece, and Lobito corridor coverage. A falling rule-of-law ranking over authoritarian concerns is a modest negative, and most other headlines are irrelevant to Zambia.

en: Independence Day anniversary greetings and celebratory coverage
Zambia's decline on global rule of law index
Routine regional trade and Lobito corridor coverage

summary.en: The period is mostly routine and mildly positive: National Day celebrations, a free school meal programme for 5.6m pupils, and a notable archaeological find. Debt-related reporting on Chinese bank loans to the state power utility is a background concern, and GDELT tone is clearly positive.

en: Free nshima programme for 5.6m pupils announced
National Day celebrations and 62nd birthday coverage
476,000-year-old wooden structure discovery in Zambia

summary.en: The period is largely routine: a small kwacha depreciation, debt and power-shortage stories, and some governance debate over a possible term extension, offset by development and investment items such as the FAO food-loss project, a new Confucius Institute and a truck launch. GDELT tone is positive, but the headlines show no clear crisis or breakthrough.

en: Kwacha slips slightly to K20.38 against the dollar
Debate over presidential term extension raises governance concerns
FAO food-loss project and new Confucius Institute opening

summary.en: The period mixes positive investment news, notably Webuild's selection as preferred bidder for a 517 km Lobito corridor railway, and a wider copper deposit find, with a cholera cluster on a passenger train and a fatal fuel tanker explosion in Lusaka. Foreign media tone is positive and the infrastructure and mining news outweighs the public health and safety incidents.

en: Webuild named preferred bidder for 517 km Lobito corridor railway
Dumbwa copper zone found more than twice as wide
Cholera cases on passenger train, 25 test positive

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine government business: a post-election cabinet swearing-in and reshuffle, plus investment and cooperation news with Switzerland, China and Webuild. GDELT tone is clearly more positive than the world average, with no crisis or unrest headlines.

en: Post-election cabinet of 24 ministers sworn in
Trade ties with Switzerland topping US$20 billion
Government reaffirms universal energy access by 2030

summary.en: A routine day in Zambia: new ministers were sworn in, SADC announced cooperation on medical products, and mining and energy investments were reported. Inflation edged up to 6.3% and the state owes farmers 14.6 billion kwacha, which offsets the positive tone.

en: New ministers sworn in; routine government reshuffle
Inflation narrowly up to 6.3% in October
State owes maize producers 14.6 billion kwacha

summary.en: Zambia's day mixes positive regional infrastructure news, notably the Tanzania-Angola rail link and the DRC power and freight corridor projects, with negative signals such as inflation rising to 6.3% on fuel and the government ruling out fuel subsidies. Enforcement actions like the stall demolitions and the land allocation ban are routine governance rather than crisis, so the net effect is modestly above an ordinary day.

Government rules out fuel price subsidies

summary.en: The period looks mostly routine, with a judiciary digitisation rollout and a by-election win in Mandevu pointing to functioning institutions. A cholera outbreak (30 deaths in three months) and a report on China-linked debt distress weigh against it, and GDELT tone is mildly positive.

Cholera outbreak reported with about 30 deaths in three months

summary.en: Most of the period is routine news (tourism, sport, local business), but an allAfrica report describes widespread repression in a post-election crackdown, and the state-house attack on a political rival adds to concern about political tension. The fuel-price relief measures are a modest offsetting positive.

State House attacks on political rival with militia smear
Money laundering scheme exceeding US$16M reported

summary.en: Human Rights Watch and allAfrica report widespread post-election repression and a crackdown, which is a serious concern for civil liberties and institutions. A Moody's credit upgrade and a Huawei AI program are positive economic and technology signals, but they do not offset the repression reporting.

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and positive investment news, including a $1.6B ammonia/urea plant groundbreaking, the 2027 budget approval and a ZAMVAX deal. Offsetting these are a report of a post-election crackdown, a cholera outbreak mention and a government challenge to an EU election observation report.

Government challenges EU election observation report

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with a credit rating upgrade to Caa1, new hydropower financing, and a 2027 budget approval pointing to economic stabilisation. Tone is somewhat more negative than the world average, driven by a court ruling on opposition figures, a human rights report dispute, and copper output declines.

Cabinet approves 2027 National Budget

summary.en: The period was mostly routine: police destroyed 5,000 illicit firearms, and Zambia plans to raise copper output in 2027. A cholera outbreak was mentioned in a regional roundup, and GDELT tone (-0.13) is less negative than the world average.

en: Police destroyed 5,000 illicit firearms, a public-security gain
Plans to increase copper production in 2027
Cholera outbreak noted in a regional roundup

summary.en: The period brings mostly positive economic news: the 2027 budget was unveiled, official forecasts show steady growth and a smaller deficit, and the Lobito railway is nearing financial close. Offsetting this, the sedition case against opposition leaders was moved to Lusaka and civil service restructuring drew scrutiny.

Lobito railway moves toward financial close with AFC

Tone is near the world average, and the opposition's complaints about civil service dismissals and the El Niño warning are modest concerns rather than a crisis.

Opposition criticises civil service retirements and dismissals

Mild tension and a tax rise offset a generally upbeat GDELT tone, so the day sits near a typical baseline.
