summary.en: Nepal is living with the effects of a major flood disaster: 163 students and 17 teachers from Rasuwa are still missing in the Bhotekoshi flood, there is a cholera risk, and rescue operations have been ended. Meanwhile, the Dashain festival is passing calmly, roads are reopening, aid continues, and there is success in cricket. Trade and cultural restrictions with India (a biscuit ban and a film ban) create limited tension; the weight of the disaster keeps the score below average.

en: Hundreds of students and teachers still missing in the Bhotekoshi flood
Cholera risk after the flood and the end of rescue operations
Security measures during the Dashain festival and calm celebrations
Reopening of roads and foreign aid for flood victims
Bans on products and films of Indian origin

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, centred on the Dashain festival, with heavy travel and a police security push. Negatives include unresolved flood fallout (163 students still missing), communication outages in Humla and Mugu, and a trade and film ban.

en: Bhotekoshi flood: 163 students and 17 teachers still missing
Dashain festival travel and security operations, routine celebrations
Communication disruption in Humla and Mugu after a link device fault

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: Dashain festivities, cricket hosting deals, and small infrastructure contracts. A deadly flood and landslide in the Nepal-Tibet region, with missing people and displaced families, pulls the score down slightly from an ordinary day.

en: Nepal-Tibet flood death toll and missing tourists reported
Ongoing relief for displaced people after the disaster
Routine infrastructure contracts for bridges and landslide control

summary.en: The period mixes recovery and relief news: the UN Loss and Damage Fund approved about $20 million for flood-hit communities, and trekking routes reopened. Offsetting this are ongoing flood-missing searches, a Dalit activist's long unheard protest, a Lumbini fund appointment protest, and a Tibet earthquake nearby, so the day sits modestly above an ordinary day.

en: UN Loss and Damage Fund approves about $20M aid for flood recovery
Langtang, Gosaikunda and Manaslu trekking routes reopen
Ongoing search for 54 missing after August floods

summary.en: The period is largely routine: tourism, cultural events and a court ruling strengthening language rights sit alongside flood-recovery shortfalls, stranded rural communities and a mountaineering tragedy. Negative tone is above the world average, but no crisis or crackdown appears, so the score stays near an ordinary day.

en: Court order backing Madhesh Province language law, a rights-related gain
Flood recovery funding ($20M-21.6M) far short of needs
Eight Karnali local bodies still cut off from road networks

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with several positive items: rising tourism, electricity exports to India, a climate adaptation fund approval and sporting and polio-awareness events. Offsetting this were 20 disaster incidents with eight injured, four bodies found and forecast heavy rain from a Bay of Bengal storm, and GDELT tone was somewhat more negative than the world average.

en: Electricity export revenue to India rising and tourism growing
Climate Adaptation Fund approves three Nepali projects
20 disaster incidents nationwide with eight injured

summary.en: Nepal's news this period is mostly routine, with recovery from the August floods moving forward through expanded flood-warning plans, electricity export earnings and a $21.6 million UN climate loss-and-damage payment. Offsetting this are a fatal-risk boat capsize with three people missing and a minor earthquake, so the score sits modestly above neutral.

en: Flood warning expansion and glacial lake risk plans across six basins
Electricity exports to India and Bangladesh rising, NPR 5.93 billion earned
$21.6 million UN climate loss-and-damage fund payment

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: a cyclone-driven rain and snow alert, floods and landslides blocking highways and damaging water pipelines, and road accidents. Positives include the Nepal Premier League's growing profile, a US congressional delegation meeting the Speaker, and planned flood early-warning systems, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day.

en: Cyclone Arnav warnings of heavy rain and snowfall across hill districts
Floods and landslides blocking main highways and damaging water pipelines
Nepal Premier League growth and US congressional engagement on economic ties

summary.en: Nepal's coverage over the period is dominated by a looming Cyclone Arnab warning with multi-day rain and snow, a suspension of Himalayan trekking permits, and flood survivors returning to damaged homes. Otherwise the news is routine, with some legal and sports-federation disputes, so the score sits somewhat below an ordinary day.

en: Cyclone Arnab high alert with multi-day rain, snow and storm warnings
Trekking permits suspended amid heavy snowfall and avalanche risk
Flood survivors returning to damaged homes with limited options

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: Nepal is preparing for COP31 and holding talks with India, while Cyclone Arnab brings rain and storm warnings. Institutional limbo over the constitutional bench and the Malaysian recruitment halt weigh against the score, but there is no crisis or mass unrest.

en: Cyclone Arnab storm and heavy rain warnings across Nepal
Constitutional bench formation stalled amid Supreme Court disagreements
Malaysia halts recruitment of Nepali workers

summary.en: The day's coverage is mostly routine: Cyclone Arnab brings rain and snow warnings, with its impact expected to ease after Saturday afternoon, and there are references to a recent deadly glacier flood. Positive items include the UN extending Nepal's LDC graduation preparation period to 2029, while the negative GDELT tone reflects the disaster coverage.

en: Cyclone Arnab rain and snowfall warnings, with impact expected to ease

summary.en: The period mixes routine news (weather disruptions, cricket rain delays, a film festival, India-Nepal border security talks) with a concerning press-freedom story: police raids on media outlets, journalists detained, and pressure to reveal sources. A Global Fund emergency grant for flood-hit health services points to ongoing recovery, but the media crackdown pulls the score below an ordinary day.

en: Police raids on media outlets and detention of journalists
Pressure on newsrooms to reveal news sources
Global Fund emergency funding after floods

summary.en: The period is largely routine, with flood recovery and disaster-preparedness work, a storm weakening, and a three-year extension of LDC graduation. Fitch affirms BB- rating for third year, signalling economic stability

Negatives were fatal road accidents, including the Bhimfedi crash, and an arrest of a district official, which keep the score only modestly above neutral.

Four Supreme Court judges appointed
Nepal's seven-point Himalayan agenda presented at COP31

summary.en: The period mixes political strain, with the prime minister described as beset by internal crises and a 'Nepal's real prime minister' question, and flood-related hardship with aid appeals. Positive diplomatic and infrastructure steps, including the approved Ayodhya–Janakpur train and an upcoming India visit, offset these. Overall this is a fairly ordinary, slightly positive day.
summary.ja: この期間は政治的な緊張と洪水被害による困難、そして支援の要請が入り混じっている。首相は内部危機に直面しているとされ、「ネパールの実質的な首相は誰か」という問いも浮上している。一方で、承認されたアヨーディヤー–ジャナクプル間の列車や、今後予定されているインド訪問など、外交面とインフラ面での前向きな動きがこれを相殺している。全体としては、やや前向きなごく普通の一日である。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 정치적 긴장과 홍수 피해에 따른 어려움, 그리고 지원 요청이 뒤섞여 나타난다. 총리는 내부 위기에 시달리고 있다고 묘사되며, '네팔의 실질적인 총리는 누구인가'라는 의문도 제기되고 있다. 반면 승인된 아요디야–자나크푸르 열차 노선과 예정된 인도 방문 등 긍정적인 외교 및 인프라 조치가 이러한 부담을 상쇄한다. 전반적으로 다소 긍정적인 평범한 하루이다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में राजनीतिक तनाव और बाढ़ से जुड़ी कठिनाइयाँ, साथ ही सहायता की अपीलें, एक साथ दिखती हैं। प्रधानमंत्री को आंतरिक संकटों से घिरा बताया गया है, और 'नेपाल का असली प्रधानमंत्री कौन है' जैसा सवाल भी उठा है। दूसरी ओर, अयोध्या–जनकपुर ट्रेन की मंज़ूरी और आगामी भारत यात्रा जैसे सकारात्मक कूटनीतिक और बुनियादी ढाँचे के कदम इन चिंताओं को संतुलित करते हैं। कुल मिलाकर यह एक सामान्य, कुछ हद तक सकारात्मक दिन है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει πολιτική πίεση, με τον πρωθυπουργό να περιγράφεται ως περικυκλωμένος από εσωτερικές κρίσεις και με το ερώτημα «ποιος είναι ο πραγματικός πρωθυπουργός του Νεπάλ», και δυσκολίες που προκάλεσαν πλημμύρες, με εκκλήσεις για βοήθεια. Θετικά διπλωματικά και υποδομικά βήματα, όπως η εγκεκριμένη σιδηροδρομική γραμμή Αγιόντια–Τζανακπούρ και η προγραμματισμένη επίσκεψη στην Ινδία, αντισταθμίζουν αυτά τα στοιχεία. Συνολικά, πρόκειται για μια αρκετά συνηθισμένη, ελαφρώς θετική ημέρα.
summary.tr: Dönem, siyasi gerginliklerle karışık: başbakanın iç krizlerle boğuştuğu ve 'Nepal'in gerçek başbakanı' sorusunun tartışıldığı bir süreç var. Sel kaynaklı sıkıntılar ve yardım çağrıları da yaşanıyor. Onaylanan Ayodhya–Janakpur treni ve yaklaşan Hindistan ziyareti gibi olumlu diplomatik ve altyapı adımları bunları dengeliyor. Genel olarak oldukça sıradan, hafifçe olumlu bir gün.
summary.es: El periodo combina tensiones políticas, con el primer ministro descrito como acosado por crisis internas y una pregunta sobre si es el «verdadero primer ministro de Nepal», y penurias relacionadas con las inundaciones, junto con llamamientos de ayuda. Pasos diplomáticos y de infraestructura positivos, como el tren Ayodhya–Janakpur aprobado y una próxima visita a India, compensan estos factores. En conjunto, es un día bastante normal y algo positivo.
summary.fr: La période mêle tensions politiques, le Premier ministre étant décrit comme assailli par des crises internes, et la question du « véritable Premier ministre du Népal », ainsi que des difficultés liées aux inondations et des appels à l'aide. Des avancées diplomatiques et d'infrastructure positives, notamment le train Ayodhya–Janakpur approuvé et une prochaine visite en Inde, compensent ces éléments. Dans l'ensemble, il s'agit d'une journée assez ordinaire, légèrement positive.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum vereint politische Belastungen: Der Ministerpräsident wird als von inneren Krisen geplagt beschrieben, dazu kommt die Frage nach dem „wahren Premierminister Nepals“, sowie Not infolge von Überschwemmungen mit Hilfsaufrufen. Positive diplomatische und infrastrukturelle Schritte, darunter die genehmigte Zugverbindung Ayodhya–Janakpur und ein bevorstehender Indienbesuch, gleichen dies teilweise aus. Insgesamt ist es ein eher gewöhnlicher, leicht positiver Tag.
summary.pt: O período mistura tensão política, com o primeiro-ministro descrito como assolado por crises internas e a questão do "verdadeiro primeiro-ministro do Nepal", além de dificuldades causadas por inundações e apelos de ajuda. Medidas diplomáticas e de infraestrutura positivas, incluindo o comboio Ayodhya–Janakpur aprovado e uma próxima visita à Índia, compensam esses fatores. No geral, é um dia bastante comum e ligeiramente positivo.
summary.it: Il periodo combina tensioni politiche, con il primo ministro descritto come assediato da crisi interne e con la domanda su chi sia il vero primo ministro del Nepal, e difficoltà legate alle inondazioni con appelli per aiuti. Passi diplomatici e infrastrutturali positivi, tra cui l'approvazione del treno Ayodhya–Janakpur e una prossima visita in India, controbilanciano questi elementi. Nel complesso si tratta di una giornata piuttosto ordinaria, leggermente positiva.
summary.ru: Период сочетает политическое напряжение: премьер-министр описан как человек, которого одолевают внутренние кризисы, и звучит вопрос о «настоящем премьер-министре Непала», а также тяготы, связанные с наводнениями, и призывы о помощи. Этому противостоят позитивные дипломатические и инфраструктурные шаги, включая одобрение поезда Айодхья–Джаканпур и предстоящий визит в Индию. В целом это довольно обычный, слегка позитивный день.
summary.ar: يجمع هذه الفترة بين التوتر السياسي، إذ يوصف رئيس الوزراء بأنه محاصر بأزمات داخلية، مع تساؤل حول «رئيس الوزراء الحقيقي لنيبال»، إضافة إلى المعاناة المرتبطة بالفيضانات والدعوات إلى المساعدة. وتخفف من ذلك خطوات دبلوماسية وبنية تحتية إيجابية، منها الموافقة على قطار أيودهيا–جاناكبور وزيارة مرتقبة إلى الهند. وبوجه عام، هذا يوم عادي إلى حد كبير ومتفائل قليلاً.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از فشار سیاسی است؛ نخست‌وزیر در بحران‌های داخلی گرفتار توصیف شده و پرسش «نخست‌وزیر واقعی نپال» مطرح است، و همچنین سختی‌های ناشی از سیل و درخواست‌های کمک. گام‌های مثبت دیپلماتیک و زیرساختی، از جمله تصویب قطار ایودهیا–جانکپور و سفر آتی به هند، این فشارها را تا حدی متعادل می‌کند. در مجموع این روزی نسبتاً عادی و کمی مثبت است.

summary.ar: تتألف الفترة في معظمها من أخبار روتينية مع ميل إيجابي طفيف. تثير زيارة وزير التجارة الهندي الحديث عن تعزيز العلاقات التجارية والاستثمارية، وتحظى جهود مصر في التوطين الصناعي ودفع الصادرات بالتغطية، بينما تتجاوز نبرة GDELT بوضوح المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً شامل اخبار معمولی با گرایشی اندکی مثبت است. سفر وزیر بازرگانی هند بحث‌هایی درباره تقویت روابط تجاری و سرمایه‌گذاری را مطرح می‌کند و تلاش مصر برای بومی‌سازی صنعتی و افزایش صادرات پوشش خبری می‌گیرد، در حالی که لحن GDELT به‌طور قابل توجهی بالاتر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 该时段主要为例行新闻，整体基调略偏积极。印度商务部长的访问引发了关于加强贸易和投资联系的讨论，埃及推动工业本地化和出口的举措也获得报道，GDELT的语气明显高于全球平均水平。
summary.ja: この期間の報道は大半が通常のニュースで、わずかに肯定的な傾向です。インドの通商大臣の訪問により、貿易と投資の関係強化に関する議論が広がっています。エジプトの産業の現地化と輸出拡大の取り組みも報じられており、GDELTのトーンは世界平均をかなり上回っています。
summary.ko: 이 기간의 보도는 대체로 일상적인 뉴스이며, 약간 긍정적인 경향을 보입니다. 인도 통상장관의 방문으로 무역 및 투자 관계 강화에 대한 논의가 이어지고 있으며, 이집트의 산업 현지화 및 수출 확대 추진도 보도되었습니다. GDELT 어조는 세계 평균을 크게 웃돕니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि की ख़बरें ज़्यादातर सामान्य हैं, जिनका झुकाव हल्का सकारात्मक है। भारत के वाणिज्य मंत्री की यात्रा से व्यापार और निवेश संबंधों को मज़बूत करने की चर्चा हो रही है, और मिस्र के औद्योगिक स्थानीयकरण और निर्यात बढ़ाने के प्रयासों को भी कवरेज मिली है, जबकि GDELT का लहजा विश्व औसत से काफ़ी ऊपर है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος καλύπτεται κυρίως από συνηθισμένες ειδήσεις, με ελαφρώς θετική τάση. Η επίσκεψη του υπουργού Εμπορίου της Ινδίας φέρνει συζητήσεις για ενισχυμένους εμπορικούς και επενδυτικούς δεσμούς, ενώ η προώθηση της βιομηχανικής εγχώρωσης και των εξαγωγών της Αιγύπτου έχει επίσης κάλυψη, και ο τόνος του GDELT βρίσκεται αισθητά πάνω από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.

summary.en: Iran is effectively at war with the United States. Claims of an attack on the Konarak naval base, tension in the Strait of Hormuz, a downed drone, and warnings that the war could reignite stand out. The country is becoming more economically isolated through a blockade, sanctions, and the closure of neighboring borders, and GDELT tone is also far more negative than the world average. Diplomatic contacts with Russia and Pakistan are a limited balancing factor, but negotiations are stalled.

en: Claims of a US attack on the Konarak naval base and warnings of a return to war
Tension in the Strait of Hormuz, blocked oil exports, and threats against undersea internet cables
Sanctions, blockades, and shrinking border trade with Pakistan and Turkey
Deadlocked negotiations and reports that Israel is preparing to strike alone
Diplomatic contacts with Russia (Lavrov visit) and Pakistan (Munir visit)

summary.en: Iran is in a state of unresolved US-Iran war and blockade tension, with Hormuz tanker strikes, mines, drone shootdowns, threats against undersea cables, and talk of possible new strikes dominating coverage. Peace-mediation efforts via Pakistan exist but are deadlocked, and the period is marked by severe security threats rather than clear recovery.

en: Tanker strikes and mines reported in Strait of Hormuz
US-Iran peace talks deadlocked; Iran rules out talks
Threats of US strike on Pickaxe Mountain and retaliation vows

summary.en: Iran faces an active war-like confrontation: a US naval blockade, Iranian naval attacks on ships, a Saudi airport attack, and reports of planned renewed US-Israeli strikes, with some diplomacy continuing. Combined with a sharply negative news tone and economic strain from the blockade and border closures, the period is a severe crisis.

en: Reports of planned fresh US-Israeli strikes and Iranian threats
IRGC attacks on multiple ships amid blockade
Blockade halting shadow tanker exports; border trade restrictions

summary.en: Iran is in an active US-Israel confrontation: tankers reportedly hit in the Strait of Hormuz, new strike plans under discussion, and sanctions tightening on the economy with currency controls. Diplomacy (Pakistani mediation, Putin's comments) continues but offers little offsetting relief, so the day reads as a war-level crisis.

en: Tankers and ships reportedly hit or mined in Strait of Hormuz
New US-Israel strike plans being developed against Iran
Dollar purchases capped at $1,000/day amid sanctions pressure

summary.en: Iran faces intense renewed-conflict risk: US threats of another military operation, reported Iranian plots against US diplomats, embassy staffing cuts, and plans to target Gulf undersea cables. Partial offsets include European readiness for nuclear talks, reported oil export recovery, and a planned presidential trip to Moscow, but the overall picture points to serious strain on the economy and internal repression.

en: Trump threatens another military operation against Iran
US intelligence warns of Iranian plots against American diplomats
Reports of planned strikes on Gulf undersea internet cables

summary.en: Iran is in a tense standoff with the US, with tanker blasts and mines reported near Hormuz, renewed US strike threats, and armed unrest in Sistan-Baluchestan. The only clear positive is the reopening of the Pakistan border crossing after a week-long trade halt, which does not offset the security situation.

en: Tanker blasts and naval mines reported near Strait of Hormuz
Trump hints at renewed US strikes on Iran
Armed clashes and resistance attacks reported in Sistan-Baluchestan and elsewhere

summary.en: The period is dominated by fears of renewed war after reported tanker attacks in Hormuz, an explosion at a Tabriz radar site, and public signs of anxiety such as food stockpiling. Diplomatic activity (Qatari mediation, regional security delegations) and the rescue of Iranian sailors partly offset this, but the overall picture is serious tension.

en: Reported attacks on seven oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz
Fears of a return to full-scale war with the US and Israel
Explosion reported at a radar facility in Tabriz

summary.en: Iran faces a serious security crisis, with reports of US forces ready for strikes within 96 hours and an energy and political strain. Regional diplomacy is moving forward, with Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish officials holding security talks in Tehran, a reported Qatari effort toward a five-day US-Iran deal, and an agreement to keep talking.

en: US strike readiness reported within 96 hours of Trump order
Saudi, Pakistani, Turkish security talks held in Tehran
Reported Qatari effort toward five-day US-Iran agreement

summary.en: Iran is in an unresolved war-and-crisis period: US officials warn of a renewed 'intense' strike campaign, a ceasefire has reportedly broken down, and Hormuz control is contested. Domestic stress is also high, with armed clashes in Khash, protests against death sentences, a five-year sentence for filmmaker Jafar Panahi, and warnings of large job losses. Mediation by Qatar and the Gulf states offers some de-escalation, which keeps the score above the war band.

en: US warns Gulf allies of possible intense renewed war with Iran
Ceasefire called a waste of time; Iran slams broken commitments
Armed clashes intensify in Khash; protests against death sentences

summary.en: Iran is in a 'neither war nor peace' state, with renewed US strike threats, a reported drone shootdown and a costly ongoing conflict. Diplomacy is active through mediators and a Vance outreach, but the threat of renewed war dominates the period.

en: Renewed US strike threats after midterms amid stalled war
Diplomatic outreach via mediators and Vance letter
IRGC reports US drone shot down near Hormuz

summary.en: Iran is in an active conflict with the US: strikes have resumed, Qeshm Island and a naval base were hit, and a tanker was attacked in Hormuz. Executions are rising and the economy is under blockade-related strain, which outweighs the tentative peace outreach through Vance's letter and Qatari mediation.

en: US strikes resume after Iran rejects peace-talk proposal
Explosions on Qeshm Island and Iranian naval base attack
Tanker hit by explosive devices in Strait of Hormuz

summary.en: Iran is in an active standoff with the US: tankers were hit and Hormuz traffic halted, while a draft deal to transfer uranium and reopen Hormuz within 7 days is being mediated by Qatar. Diplomatic progress is offset by ongoing military incidents and a harsh judicial sentence against filmmaker Jafar Panahi.

en: Hormuz tanker attacks and halted shipping amid US-Iran tensions
Draft US-Iran deal on uranium transfer and Hormuz reopening
Panahi sentenced to over five years in prison

summary.en: Iran is in a tense standoff: renewed US and Israeli strike threats, a disputed incident off Qeshm Island, and Hormuz shipping still closed. Mediated diplomacy through Qatar and Oman-style channels is active but unresolved, which keeps the period in the serious-problems range.

en: Trump and Netanyahu threaten renewed strikes on Iranian nuclear sites
Strait of Hormuz reopening conditional on US concessions
Claimed US strike on fishing boats off Qeshm Island

en: US strikes on Iran and renewed threats of further strikes
Tankers hit or mined near Hormuz; shipping under attack
Oil prices near $110 amid war and stalled talks

summary.en: Iran is in an active armed conflict with the United States, with fresh US strikes on Qeshm Island, explosions at Bandar Lengeh, a naval blockade and claims of mariners killed. Talks to end the war continue but have produced no deal, so the period is dominated by war and threats of further strikes.

en: US strikes on Qeshm Island and explosions reported in Iran
Naval blockade and drone shootdowns near Strait of Hormuz
Talks ended without deal; threats of renewed strikes continue

summary.en: Iran remains in an active standoff with the US: recent US strikes on Qeshm, mines and tanker losses in Hormuz, and executions and attacks inside Iran. Mediation via Qatar and a Trump pause on new strikes offer some de-escalation, which keeps the score above the war band.

en: US strike on Qeshm confirmed; Iran warns of retaliation
Tankers destroyed after hitting mines in Hormuz
Executions of January uprising prisoners in Isfahan

summary.en: Iran is in an ongoing confrontation with the US, with Washington threatening to 'finish the job' and Tehran warning of a strong response to further strikes. Domestic repression also continues, including student crackdowns, expulsions and executions, though markets and some US commentary point to possible de-escalation.

en: Iran warns of strong response to further US strikes
Crackdown on student protesters with expulsions and hearings
Executions of uprising prisoners continue in Isfahan

summary.en: Iran remains in an active war with the US and Israel, with tanker attacks in Hormuz, oil near $100, and renewed US strike threats. Diplomacy continues through a nuclear proposal sent via Qatar, and reports cite executions of protesters and arrests, which keeps the score in the crisis range.

en: Ongoing war with US-Israel and renewed strike threats
Tanker attacks in Hormuz and oil surging toward $100
Iran's nuclear proposal and seven conditions via Qatar and Russia

summary.en: Iran is in an active military confrontation with the US, with fresh strikes on air defences, drones shot down, and missiles reported over Qeshm. Qatari mediation and renewed diplomatic contacts offer some counterweight, but the period is dominated by war and escalation risk.

Iran reports downing US drones over Qeshm Island and missile impacts there
Qatar-mediated nuclear proposals under review, a partial de-escalation signal

summary.en: The period is dominated by escalating naval confrontation with the US around the Strait of Hormuz, including a US blockade, disabled vessels, reported strikes on Qeshm Island, and tankers damaged by mines. Domestic and foreign media also report three executions linked to protests, which adds to the sense of severe pressure on the country.

Explosions on Qeshm Island and tankers hit by mines

summary.en: The period is dominated by an active US-Iran conflict: strikes on Qeshm Island, mines hitting tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, a Houthi strike on Aramco, and fuel rationing blamed on military aggression. Talks and Trump's remarks that renewed attacks are 'highly unlikely' offer only a weak de-escalation signal.

Iranian officials threatening 'collapse' and 'hell' if aggression continues
Fuel conservation appeals tied to military attacks on gas production

Netanyahu reportedly pushing daily to resume strikes on Iran

Diplomacy through Qatar and talk of a possible end to hostilities offer some counterweight, but the overall picture is dominated by armed conflict and very negative news tone.

en: Threats of renewed US/Israeli war and Iranian retaliation warnings against European bases
Tentative US-Iran talks considered, with conditions still unresolved
Farm fertilizer prices doubling ahead of planting season

Domestic strain is also severe, with near-100% regional inflation, fuel restrictions, wage arrears and bread shortages. A few de-escalation signals, such as a US official saying further military action is not needed, do not offset these pressures.

IRGC threats of harsher strikes after claimed radar attack in Bahrain
Regional inflation near 100% in Zanjan, Khuzestan and Razavi Khorasan

summary.en: Iran is in an unresolved military standoff with the US: Iran claims drone and missile strikes on a US base and radar in Bahrain, and reports of a downed US drone. Foreign reports describe desperate households selling organs as the war drags on, and domestic media flag fuel supply problems, so the period sits in the war-and-humanitarian-strain band.
summary.it: L'Iran è in una situazione di stallo militare irrisolto con gli Stati Uniti: Teheran afferma di aver colpito con droni e missili una base statunitense e un radar in Bahrein, e riferisce dell'abbattimento di un drone statunitense. Resoconti stranieri descrivono famiglie disperate che vendono organi mentre la guerra si protrae, e i media nazionali segnalano problemi nell'approvvigionamento di carburante; il periodo rientra quindi nella fascia della guerra e delle tensioni umanitarie.
summary.ru: Иран находится в неурегулированном военном противостоянии с США: Иран заявляет о ударах беспилотников и ракет по американской базе и радиолокационной станции в Бахрейне, а также сообщает о сбитом американском беспилотнике. Зарубежные источники пишут о том, что отчаявшиеся семьи продают органы по мере затягивания войны, а отечественные СМИ отмечают проблемы с поставками топлива, поэтому данный период относится к категории войны и гуманитарного напряжения.
summary.ar: إيران في مواجهة عسكرية غير محسومة مع الولايات المتحدة: تزعم إيران شن هجمات بطائرات مسيّرة وصواريخ على قاعدة أمريكية ورادار في البحرين، وتفيد التقارير بإسقاط طائرة أمريكية مسيّرة. وتصف تقارير أجنبية أسراً يائسة تبيع أعضاءها مع استمرار الحرب، بينما تشير وسائل إعلام محلية إلى مشكلات في إمدادات الوقود، لذا تندرج الفترة ضمن نطاق الحرب والضغوط الإنسانية.
summary.fa: ایران در یک رویارویی نظامی حل‌نشده با ایالات متحده قرار دارد: ایران ادعا می‌کند که پایگاه و رادار آمریکا در بحرین را با پهپاد و موشک هدف قرار داده، و گزارش‌هایی از سرنگونی یک پهپاد آمریکایی منتشر شده است. گزارش‌های خارجی از خانواده‌های نومید سخن می‌گویند که با ادامه جنگ اعضای بدن خود را می‌فروشند، و رسانه‌های داخلی به مشکلات تأمین سوخت اشاره می‌کنند؛ از این رو این دوره در محدوده جنگ و فشارهای بشردوستانه قرار می‌گیرد.
summary.zh: 伊朗与美国之间的军事对峙尚未平息：伊朗声称对巴林的一处美军基地和雷达设施发动了无人机和导弹袭击，并有报道称一架美国无人机被击落。外国报道描述，随着战事拖延，一些走投无路的家庭开始出售器官；国内媒体则提到燃料供应问题，因此这一时期属于战争与人道主义压力的范畴。
summary.tr: İran, ABD ile çözülmemiş bir askeri çıkmaz içinde: İran, Bahreyn'deki bir ABD üssüne ve radara İHA ve füze saldırıları düzenlediğini iddia ediyor; ayrıca bir ABD İHA'sının düşürüldüğüne dair haberler var. Yabancı haberler, savaş uzadıkça çaresiz hanelerin organlarını sattığını anlatıyor; yerel medya ise yakıt tedarikiyle ilgili sorunlara dikkat çekiyor. Dolayısıyla dönem, savaş ve insani baskı kuşağında yer alıyor.
summary.es: Irán se encuentra en un enfrentamiento militar sin resolver con EE. UU.: Irán afirma haber lanzado ataques con drones y misiles contra una base estadounidense y un radar en Baréin, y hay informes de un dron estadounidense derribado. Medios extranjeros describen a hogares desesperados que venden órganos mientras la guerra se prolonga, y medios nacionales señalan problemas de suministro de combustible, por lo que el periodo se ubica en la franja de guerra y presión humanitaria.
summary.fr: L'Iran se trouve dans une impasse militaire non résolue avec les États-Unis : Téhéran affirme avoir mené des frappes de drones et de missiles contre une base américaine et un radar à Bahreïn, et des informations font état d'un drone américain abattu. Des médias étrangers décrivent des foyers désespérés vendant leurs organes alors que la guerre se prolonge, tandis que des médias nationaux signalent des problèmes d'approvisionnement en carburant ; la période relève donc de la catégorie guerre et tensions humanitaires.
summary.de: Iran befindet sich in einer ungelösten militärischen Pattsituation mit den USA: Iran behauptet, Drohnen- und Raketenangriffe auf einen US-Stützpunkt und ein Radar in Bahrain geflogen zu haben, und es gibt Berichte über eine abgeschossene US-Drohne. Ausländische Berichte beschreiben verzweifelte Haushalte, die angesichts des andauernden Krieges Organe verkaufen, und inländische Medien weisen auf Probleme bei der Treibstoffversorgung hin; der Zeitraum gehört damit zur Kategorie Krieg und humanitäre Belastung.
summary.pt: O Irã está em um impasse militar não resolvido com os EUA: o Irã afirma ter realizado ataques com drones e mísseis contra uma base americana e um radar no Bahrein, e há relatos de um drone americano abatido. Veículos estrangeiros descrevem famílias desesperadas vendendo órgãos enquanto a guerra se arrasta, e a mídia doméstica aponta problemas no abastecimento de combustível; o período se enquadra, portanto, na faixa de guerra e pressão humanitária.
summary.ja: イランは米国との間で未解決の軍事的対峙が続いている。イランは、バーレーンの米軍基地およびレーダー施設へのドローンとミサイルによる攻撃を主張しており、米軍ドローンが撃墜されたとの報道もある。外国メディアは、戦争の長期化に伴い困窮した世帯が臓器を売っていると報じ、国内メディアは燃料供給の問題を指摘している。この期間は戦争と人道的負担の区分に位置づけられる。
summary.ko: 이란과 미국 간에는 해결되지 않은 군사적 대치 상태가 이어지고 있다. 이란은 바레인에 있는 미군 기지와 레이더에 대한 드론 및 미사일 공격을 주장하고 있으며, 미군 드론이 격추되었다는 보도도 있다. 외신은 전쟁이 장기화되면서 생계가 절박한 가정들이 장기를 팔고 있다고 보도했고, 국내 언론은 연료 공급 문제를 지적하고 있다. 이 기간은 전쟁 및 인도적 부담 범주에 해당한다.
summary.hi: ईरान और अमेरिका के बीच एक अनसुलझा सैन्य टकराव जारी है। ईरान ने बहरीन में एक अमेरिकी बेस और रडार पर ड्रोन और मिसाइल हमलों का दावा किया है, और एक अमेरिकी ड्रोन को गिराए जाने की रिपोर्टें भी हैं। विदेशी रिपोर्टों में युद्ध लंबा खिंचने के साथ बेहाल परिवारों द्वारा अंग बेचने की बात कही गई है, जबकि घरेलू मीडिया ईंधन आपूर्ति की समस्याओं को उजागर कर रहा है, इसलिए यह अवधि युद्ध और मानवीय दबाव वाली श्रेणी में आती है।
summary.el: Το Ιράν βρίσκεται σε ανεπίλυτο στρατιωτικό αδιέξοδο με τις ΗΠΑ: το Ιράν ισχυρίζεται επιθέσεις με drones και πυραύλους σε αμερικανική βάση και ραντάρ στο Μπαχρέιν, και αναφέρονται περιπτώσεις κατάρριψης αμερικανικού drone. Ξένες αναφορές περιγράφουν απελπισμένα νοικοκυριά που πουλούν όργανα καθώς ο πόλεμος συνεχίζεται, ενώ τα εγχώρια μέσα ενημέρωσης επισημαίνουν προβλήματα στην προμήθεια καυσίμων, οπότε η περίοδος εντάσσεται στην κατηγορία πολέμου και ανθρωπιστικής πίεσης.

summary.it: La copertura della giornata è per lo più di routine: conservazione marina, un forum di imprenditori, programmi di lavoro per donne e giovani madri e un accordo di cooperazione militare con gli Stati Uniti in attesa di firma. summary.zh: 当日报道大多属于常规内容：海洋保护、企业家论坛、面向妇女和年轻母亲的就业计划，以及待签的美国军事合作协议。南部非洲发展共同体（SADC）呼吁举行可信选举，显示持续的政治关注；在全球平均语气偏负面的背景下，GDELT语气略为正面，因此得分略高于普通的一天。

SADC'nin güvenilir seçimler çağrısı süregelen siyasi ilgiye işaret ediyor; GDELT tonu negatif dünya ortalamasına karşı hafif olumlu, bu nedenle puan sıradan bir günün biraz üzerinde seyrediyor.
summary.es: La cobertura del día es mayormente rutinaria: conservación marina, un foro de emprendedores, programas de empleo para mujeres y madres jóvenes, y un acuerdo de cooperación militar con Estados Unidos pendiente. El llamado de la SADC a elecciones creíbles indica una atención política continua, y el tono de GDELT es levemente positivo frente a un promedio mundial negativo, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa modestamente por encima de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La couverture du jour est en grande partie routinière : conservation marine, un forum des entrepreneurs, des programmes d'emploi pour les femmes et les jeunes mères, et un accord de coopération militaire avec les États-Unis en attente. L'appel de la SADC à des élections crédibles témoigne d'une attention politique continue, et le ton de GDELT est légèrement positif face à une moyenne mondiale négative, si bien que le score se situe modestement au-dessus d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Die Berichterstattung des Tages ist überwiegend routinemäßig: Meeresschutz, ein Unternehmerforum, Beschäftigungsprogramme für Frauen und junge Mütter sowie ein ausstehendes militärisches Kooperationsabkommen mit den USA. Der Aufruf der SADC zu glaubwürdigen Wahlen zeigt anhaltende politische Aufmerksamkeit, und der GDELT-Ton ist im Vergleich zum negativen Weltdurchschnitt leicht positiv, sodass der Wert etwas über einem gewöhnlichen Tag liegt.
summary.pt: A cobertura do dia é em grande parte rotineira: conservação marinha, um fórum de empreendedores, programas de emprego para mulheres e mães jovens, e um acordo de cooperação militar com os EUA pendente. O apelo da SADC por eleições credíveis sinaliza atenção política contínua, e o tom do GDELT é levemente positivo em relação a uma média mundial negativa, pelo que a pontuação fica moderadamente acima de um dia comum.
summary.ja: 本日の報道は大半が定例的なものです。海洋保全、起業家フォーラム、女性と若い母親向けの雇用プログラム、そして保留中の米軍事協力協定などが含まれます。SADCによる信頼できる選挙の要請は、政治面での継続的な関心を示しています。GDELTのトーンは、世界平均がネガティブである中でわずかにポジティブであり、そのためスコアは平均的な一日をやや上回る水準にあります。
summary.ko: 오늘 보도는 대부분 일상적인 내용입니다. 해양 보전, 기업가 포럼, 여성과 젊은 엄마를 위한 일자리 프로그램, 그리고 계류 중인 미국 군사 협력 협정 등이 포함되어 있습니다. SADC가 신뢰할 수 있는 선거를 요구한 것은 정치 분야에 대한 지속적인 관심을 보여줍니다. 전 세계 평균이 부정적인 가운데 GDELT 논조는 약간 긍정적이어서, 점수는 평범한 하루보다 다소 높은 수준입니다.
summary.hi: आज की कवरेज ज़्यादातर नियमित प्रकृति की है: समुद्री संरक्षण, उद्यमियों का मंच, महिलाओं और युवा माताओं के लिए रोज़गार कार्यक्रम, और अमेरिका के साथ लंबित सैन्य सहयोग समझौता। SADC द्वारा विश्वसनीय चुनावों की माँग राजनीतिक क्षेत्र में जारी ध्यान का संकेत देती है। GDELT का स्वर विश्व औसत के नकारात्मक होने के बावजूद हल्का सकारात्मक है, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से कुछ ऊपर है।
summary.el: Η σημερινή κάλυψη είναι κυρίως συνηθισμένη: προστασία της θαλάσσιας ζωής, φόρουμ επιχειρηματιών, προγράμματα απασχόλησης για γυναίκες και νέες μητέρες, καθώς και μια εκκρεμής συμφωνία στρατιωτικής συνεργασίας με τις ΗΠΑ. Η έκκληση της SADC για αξιόπιστες εκλογές δείχνει συνεχιζόμενο πολιτικό ενδιαφέρον, και ο τόνος του GDELT είναι ελαφρώς θετικός σε σύγκριση με τον αρνητικό παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται μετρια πάνω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.

Les tensions régionales autour du détroit d'Ormuz, avec un pétrolier touché par une mine navale, et une baisse de 6,7 % du nombre de passagers aériens tempèrent ce bilan.

A tensão regional em torno do Estreito de Ormuz, com um petroleiro atingido por uma mina naval, e uma queda de 6,7% no número de passageiros dos aeroportos moderam a avaliação.

summary.en: Forming a new government in Iraq, collecting weapons under state control, and debates over quota-sharing (power distribution) continue, but there is no major violence or crisis headline. Oil exports are approaching pre-war levels, and foreign oil companies and investors are showing interest, which paints a mildly positive economic picture. Concerns about a fiscal crisis, uncertainty over dinar devaluation, and tensions with armed groups limit the score.

en: Oil exports approaching pre-war levels at 3.4 million barrels/day
Interest from major oil companies and investors in Iraq
Decision to bring weapons under state control, with enforcement under the counterterrorism law
Fiscal crisis, dinar devaluation, and criticism of quota-sharing in the government
Regional diplomacy: hosting Iran–Gulf talks and security cooperation with the KRG

summary.en: The period mixes serious strains with some positive signals. Dinar devaluation, protest warnings, a deadly Daesh attack that killed dozens of security personnel, and a border closure with Iran under US pressure weigh heavily. Gains such as an improved hunger ranking, a returning container line and oil majors eyeing re-entry partly offset them.

en: Dinar devaluation and protest warnings hit household finances
Burial of dozens of security personnel killed by Daesh
Iraq threatens crackdown on opponents of disarmament plan

summary.en: The period mixes regional strain (closure of the al-Sheeb crossing with Iran amid reported US pressure, denial of Houthi bases, new security curbs on cross-border attacks) and economic pressure (dollar near 170,000 dinars, reserves down about $16bn in 2026). Positives include the resumption of commercial shipping after 50 years, oil majors investing, and routine anti-narcotics seizures, so the day sits modestly below an ordinary period.

en: Al-Sheeb border crossing with Iran closed amid reported US pressure
Dinar pressure: dollar near 170,000, reserves down $16bn in 2026
Commercial shipping resumes after 50 years, a positive development

summary.en: The period mixes a completed cabinet formation, new aviation certifications and Development Road talks with regional strain: an apparent US-Iran conflict, Iran cutting internet access, armed factions resisting disarmament and a hospital chemotherapy shortage. Net, it reads as an ordinary day with slightly more negative tone than average.

en: Cabinet formation completed, signalling institutional progress
Regional US-Iran conflict and Iran internet cut weigh on outlook
Armed factions reportedly refusing disarmament plan

summary.en: Iraq's news mix is largely routine, with sovereignty signals such as the announced exit of US forces and the government's pledge on arms control. Those are offset by fears that a renewed US-Iran conflict could drag in Iraq, airspace violation concerns, and a repelled ISIS attack in Kirkuk.

en: Fears of renewed US-Iran war and armed factions joining
Announced US troop withdrawal and government sovereignty claims
Airspace violation concerns and ISIS attack repelled in Kirkuk

summary.en: Iraq's day mixed routine governance (the 2027 budget with new jobs, the Faw port nearing trials, and a Turkey-Iraq deal ending a decade-long dispute over the Bashiqa camp) with serious regional risk. Reports of possible Israeli strikes on Chinese air defenses, US travel warnings, militia airspace accusations and renewed Tishreen protest fears, plus a markedly negative news tone, pull the score below an ordinary day.

en: Turkey-Iraq agreement to hand over Bashiqa camp ends long dispute
Reports of Israeli strike on Chinese air defenses in Iraq
US travel warning citing inability to guarantee citizens' safety

summary.en: A mixed day: Baghdad announced steps toward integrating Sinjar security forces into the national army, and reconstruction and cultural projects advanced. Against that, Maysan threatened civil disobedience over the Shib border closure, Iran struck a Kurdish opposition base with drones, and the 2027 budget faces austerity and a large borrowing operation.

en: Sinjar security forces to be integrated into the Iraqi army
Maysan civil disobedience threat over Shib crossing closure
Iranian drone strike on Kurdish opposition base in Iraq

summary.en: Iraq's day mixed institutional progress with internal friction: the Sinjar armed group's disarmament and integration into the army and the 2027 budget and Development Road plans point to stronger state control. Against that, a Maysan council chief faces an arrest warrant over civil-disobedience threats, a Shia faction is pushing back against the government, and the Iran border closure and Hormuz disruption are straining the economy.

en: Sinjar PKK-linked units disarming and integrating into Iraqi army
Arrest warrant for Maysan council chief after secession and civil-disobedience threats
Iran border crossing closure dispute and Shia faction pushback

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and diplomacy (Syria and Jordan ties, reserves recovering, salaries secured) with security strain: drones downed near the US Embassy in Baghdad and an Iran border closure amid regional war. Economic pressure from blocked Hormuz trade and dollar smuggling offsets the positives, so the day sits modestly below an ordinary one.

en: Drones shot down near US Embassy in Baghdad, raising security alerts
Iran border crossing closure and blocked goods via Hormuz strain trade
Central bank reports dollar reserves recovering; salary funding secured for 2027

summary.en: The period was mostly positive, led by the handover of Sinjar security posts to the Iraqi army and the integration of about 4,000 YBŞ members into the forces, with Turkey welcoming it. Economic news was mixed: the lifting of foreign ownership limits, an automotive hub and Syria oil-export talks were offset by budget-deficit worries, IMF conditions, goods stranded in Hormuz and a drone incident in Baghdad.

en: Sinjar security posts handed to the Iraqi army; PKK-linked YBŞ integrated
Turkey welcomes Baghdad's authority over Sinjar and Bashiqa base handover
Foreign ownership restrictions lifted; non-oil revenue and trade expansion

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: weather, sports, a court sentencing, and cultural and local news. Modest positives include the Central Bank reporting the exchange-rate gap narrowing to 9%, progress toward a Sinjar settlement, and corruption convictions, offset by a new IMF loan request and a very negative news tone.

en: Central Bank says exchange-rate gap narrowed to 9%
Sinjar settlement talks and Baghdad-Ankara understanding reported
Anti-corruption court convictions of two MPs and an oil official

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: sports, real estate, trade data and cultural news. Mild positives include the Sinjar integration of about 4,300 people and a literacy programme, offset by Kirkuk protests, drone tensions in Baghdad and a PM takeover of intelligence.

en: Baghdad integrates about 4,300 people in Sinjar, a reconciliation step
Kirkuk protests over 12 demands, with no crackdown reported
Armed faction warns US over Iraqi airspace; drone tensions in Baghdad

summary.en: The period was mostly routine: Development Road and a $210 million housing contract offset local protests in Maysan, a drone interception that prompted a security meeting, and a radioactive source found in Babylon. Overall tone is slightly more negative than the world average, but no clear crisis appears in the headlines.

en: Drone interception prompted the prime minister to convene security agencies
Maysan protests renewed over reopening the Shaib crossing
Development Road expected to cut Europe trade time by 11 days

summary.en: The period is mixed: a $3 billion US-backed dollar injection, an 85% drop in armed clashes, and anti-corruption operations are offset by a fiscal deficit above $22 billion, fears of a regional strike involving Iran, and a negative news tone. Overall this looks like a routine period with no clear crisis or clear breakthrough.

en: US-Iran war tensions and fears of a strike on Iraq
$3 billion dollar injection to support the currency
Reported 85% drop in armed clashes

summary.en: The period mixes clear positives, including higher oil exports via Turkey, a central bank reserve jump, and a PKK pullback from Karaçok, with serious risks: fears of regional war spillover, a renewed Hormuz closure threat, a Basra crude price drop, and an unresolved salary dispute with Erbil. Protests over Kirkuk generator fees were answered with a fee cut, and the overall tone is more negative than the world average, so the score sits modestly above a routine day.

en: Oil exports via Turkey rise to 500,000 barrels a day
Central bank reserves jump by over 12 trillion dinars
PKK withdraws from Karaçok; control passes to Iraqi army and Peshmerga

summary.en: The period mixes serious strains: a US warning over disarming factions, fears of armed groups spiralling amid a renewed regional war, border closures, protests over generator prices in Kirkuk, and salary delays across Kurdistan. Positives include rising oil exports, a Chevron deal, an EU business forum, and anti-corruption arrests, and the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: US warning to Baghdad over disarming factions and fears of war
Salary delays hitting 91% of Kurdistan employees
Kirkuk protests over generator pricing and electricity crisis

summary.en: The period mixes economic and diplomatic positives (rising October oil exports, Bahrain partnership talks, gas financing plans, a new Baghdad museum) with serious stresses: an 11% drop in Basra crude, Iranian attacks on Kurdish groups in the north, and armed factions resisting disarmament. Overall the news flow is more negative than a typical day, but there is no clear crisis.

en: Basra crude fell 11%, a sharp economic shock
Iranian attacks on Kurdish military base and opposition groups
Armed factions refuse to hand over weapons after coalition exit

summary.en: Iraq faces serious external pressure as regional war fears on Iran grow, with Baghdad pledging not to let its territory be used for attacks and issuing a NOTAM. Domestic strain is also visible in the Kurdistan power-sharing collapse, a weak parliament, and rising living costs, partly offset by routine economic and infrastructure news.

en: Baghdad seeks to avoid regional war involving Iran and its militias
Kurdish ruling coalition breakdown as a party quits Kurdistan government
Iraq issues NOTAM amid fears of military operations

summary.en: Iraq faces serious pressure: fears of a US-Iran war prompted emergency planning, the Kurdistan Regional Government is in a political crisis after the PUK withdrew and threatened a parallel administration, and the dinar's devaluation is freezing markets. Some diplomatic efforts, such as the prime minister's contacts with Washington and the refusal to allow its territory to be used for strikes, partly offset this.

en: Risk of US-Iran war with Iraqi emergency military and civilian plans
PUK exit from Kurdistan government and threat of parallel administration
Dinar devaluation freezing markets and straining living costs

summary.en: Iraq faces mounting pressure over a possible US military strike on Iran and US demands to close Iran border crossings, alongside a stalled 2027 budget, a widening fiscal deficit, and a dollar-market freeze. Flood deaths and Kurdish-Baghdad tensions add strain, though positives such as OPEC production talks, growing electronic payments and a free hospital project limit the downgrade.

en: Threat of US strikes on Iran and pressure to close border crossings
Two years without annual budgets; 2027 budget stalled, investment frozen
Fiscal deficit concerns and dollar market freeze

summary.en: A drone attack halted production at the Khor Mor gas field, cutting about 2,800 MW of Kurdistan's power, and US pressure over Iran border crossings and war-plan reports raised security fears. Partial positives, including the start of Turkey's Zelkan base handover, a Turkey-Iraq security committee and Bahrain restoring its envoy, do not offset the energy and security shock.

en: Khor Mor gas field drone attack cuts about 2,800 MW of power
US demands Iraq close most Iran border crossings; war-fear reports
Turkey begins Zelkan handover and Iraq-Turkey security committee activates

summary.en: The period mixes positive steps, including Turkish troop withdrawal, reopened Iran border crossings, and returns of displaced families, with serious strains: a drone strike that knocked out the Khor Mor gas field and cut 2.8 GW of power, a 7% oil price fall, a large budget deficit, and a Kurdish party feud. The net effect is a below-typical day, though not a crisis.

en: Drone strike halts Khor Mor gas field, cutting 2.8 GW of power
Turkish troop withdrawal and Iran border crossings reopened
Budget deficit above 36 trillion dinars and oil price falling 7%

summary.en: The period mixes de-escalation signals, including the end of the U.S.-Iran war, reopened border crossings, progress on militia disarmament talks and a Baghdad-Erbil budget deal, with economic strain from a sharp oil price drop and a widening dollar gap. A suspected assassination of a former MP in Beirut adds a negative note, but the overall picture is close to an ordinary news day.

en: End of U.S.-Iran war and easing tensions reported
Baghdad progress on militia disarmament talks
Oil price slump pressuring 2027 budget

summary.en: The period mixes routine political and economic news with several tensions: oil-smuggling inquiries, a militia disarmament deadline, a Kurdistan budget dispute and a fatal attack on a figure in Beirut. Positive signals include the reopening of the Iran border crossing, a court restoring a telecom licence and a Kurdish dialogue initiative. Overall the picture is slightly below an ordinary day, consistent with the negative GDELT tone.

en: Iran border crossing reopened after three weeks of closure
Oil-smuggling inquiries and militia disarmament deadline pressure
Kurdistan budget dispute and Kirkuk governor vote delayed

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic and development news (record oil output, the Faw port tunnel opening, a renewables fund) with a serious Kurdish political rift and tension over militia disarmament and oil smuggling probes. GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, but there is no violence or institutional collapse, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day.

en: Kurdistan PUK-KDP rift described as largest political crisis
Oil output rose to 4.88 million barrels per day in October
Government-militia tension and US demands to disarm brigades

summary.en: A mixed day: Hormuz disruption forced oil exports onto a Syria route and a government committee moved into Jurf al-Sakhar against oil smuggling, while the central bank claimed the currency risk had passed. Security incidents, Kurdistan political rifts and controversy over a Jewish museum add negative pressure, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Hormuz disruption pushes oil exports onto a Syria route
Government committee enters Jurf al-Sakhar to probe oil smuggling
Claim that currency reserve drain has been halted

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance news with some mild positives, including the PM dismissing nine officials over oil smuggling and a Kirkuk governor being elected. Negatives include the dinar weakening past 170,000 per dollar, budget and revenue disputes, price rises after a border closure, and the killing of a former MP in Beirut. GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, so the score sits slightly below neutral.
summary.it: Il periodo combina notizie di governo di routine con alcuni lievi aspetti positivi, tra cui il licenziamento da parte del primo ministro di nove funzionari per il contrabbando di petrolio e l'elezione del governatore di Kirkuk. Gli aspetti negativi includono l'indebolimento del dinaro oltre quota 170,000 per dollaro, controversie su bilancio ed entrate, aumenti dei prezzi dopo la chiusura di un valico di frontiera e l'uccisione a Beirut di un ex deputato. Il tono di GDELT è più negativo della media mondiale, quindi il punteggio si colloca leggermente al di sotto della neutralità.
summary.ru: Период сочетает рутинные новости государственного управления с некоторыми умеренно позитивными моментами, включая увольнение премьер-министром девяти чиновников из-за контрабанды нефти и избрание губернатора Киркука. Негативные факторы включают ослабление динара за пределы 170,000 за доллар, споры о бюджете и доходах, рост цен после закрытия границы и убийство бывшего депутата парламента в Бейруте. Тональность GDELT более негативна, чем среднемировая, поэтому оценка немного ниже нейтральной.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين أخبار الحكم الروتينية وبعض الإيجابيات الطفيفة، ومنها إقالة رئيس الوزراء تسعة مسؤولين في قضية تهريب النفط، وانتخاب محافظ كركوك. وتشمل السلبيات تراجع الدينار إلى ما بعد 170,000 مقابل الدولار، والخلافات حول الميزانية والإيرادات، وارتفاع الأسعار بعد إغلاق المنفذ الحدودي، ومقتل نائب سابق في بيروت. ونبرة GDELT أكثر سلبية من المتوسط العالمي، لذلك تقع النتيجة أدنى قليلاً من الحياد.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از اخبار روتین حکمرانی و چند نکته مثبت جزئی است، از جمله برکناری نه مقام توسط نخست‌وزیر در پی تحقیقات قاچاق نفت و انتخاب استاندار کرکوک. جنبه‌های منفی شامل تضعیف دینار به بیش از 170,000 در برابر هر دلار، اختلاف بر سر بودجه و درآمد، افزایش قیمت‌ها پس از بسته شدن مرز ماندلی، و قتل یک نماینده سابق مجلس در بیروت است. لحن GDELT منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است، از این رو امتیاز اندکی پایین‌تر از خنثی قرار دارد.
summary.zh: 本时段将例行施政新闻与一些轻微积极因素混合在一起，包括总理因石油走私调查而解职九名官员，以及基尔库克省长当选。负面因素包括第纳尔兑美元跌破170,000、预算和收入争议、边境关闭后物价上涨，以及前议员在贝鲁特遇害。GDELT的语气比全球平均水平更为负面，因此得分略低于中性。
summary.tr: Dönem, rutin yönetim haberlerini bazı hafif olumlu gelişmelerle bir arada içeriyor; bunlar arasında Başbakan'ın petrol kaçakçılığı nedeniyle dokuz yetkiliyi görevden alması ve Kerkük valisinin seçilmesi yer alıyor. Olumsuz gelişmeler arasında dinarın dolar karşısında 170.000'in üzerine çıkması, bütçe ve gelir anlaşmazlıkları, bir sınır kapısının kapatılmasının ardından yaşanan fiyat artışları ve Beyrut'ta eski bir milletvekilinin öldürülmesi bulunuyor. GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasından daha olumsuz olduğundan, puan nötrün hafifçe altında yer alıyor.
summary.es: El periodo combina noticias rutinarias de gobernanza con algunos aspectos moderadamente positivos, como la destitución de nueve funcionarios por el destituyente primer ministro por contrabando de petróleo y la elección de un gobernador de Kirkuk. Entre los aspectos negativos figuran la debilitación del dinar, que superó los 170.000 por dólar, las disputas presupuestarias y de ingresos, la subida de precios tras el cierre de una frontera y el asesinato de un exdiputado en Beirut. El tono de GDELT es más negativo que la media mundial, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa ligeramente por debajo de neutral.
summary.fr: La période mêle des actualités gouvernementales de routine à quelques éléments modérément positifs, notamment la révocation de neuf responsables par le Premier ministre dans une affaire de contrebande de pétrole et l'élection d'un gouverneur de Kirkouk. Les éléments négatifs comprennent la dépréciation du dinar, qui a dépassé 170 000 pour un dollar, les différends budgétaires et fiscaux, la hausse des prix après la fermeture d'une frontière, et l'assassinat d'un ancien député à Beyrouth. Le ton GDELT est plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale, de sorte que le score se situe légèrement en dessous du neutre.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verbindet routinemäßige Regierungsnachrichten mit einigen leicht positiven Entwicklungen, darunter die Entlassung von neun Beamten durch den Premierminister wegen Ölschmuggels und die Wahl eines Gouverneurs in Kirkuk. Zu den negativen Aspekten zählen die Abwertung des Dinar, der über 170.000 pro Dollar stieg, Streitigkeiten über Haushalt und Einnahmen, Preissteigerungen nach einer Grenzschließung sowie die Tötung eines ehemaligen Abgeordneten in Beirut. Der GDELT-Ton ist negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt, weshalb der Wert leicht unter neutral liegt.
summary.pt: O período combina notícias governamentais de rotina com alguns aspectos levemente positivos, incluindo a demissão de nove funcionários pelo primeiro-ministro por contrabando de petróleo e a eleição de um governador de Kirkuk. Entre os aspectos negativos estão a desvalorização do dinar, que ultrapassou 170.000 por dólar, disputas sobre orçamento e receitas, aumento de preços após o fechamento de uma fronteira e o assassinato de um ex-deputado em Beirute. O tom do GDELT é mais negativo que a média mundial, por isso a pontuação fica ligeiramente abaixo do neutro.
summary.ja: この期間は、定例の統治に関するニュースに、いくつかの穏やかな前向きな出来事が混ざっています。首相が石油密輸の捜査を受けて9人の官僚を解任したこと、そしてキルクークの知事が選出されたことが含まれます。否定的な要素としては、ディナールが1ドルあたり170,000を超えて下落したこと、予算と歳入をめぐる対立、国境閉鎖後の物価上昇、そしてベイルートで元国会議員が殺害されたことがあります。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりも否定的であるため、スコアは中立をわずかに下回っています。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 일상적인 행정 뉴스와 함께 몇 가지 완만한 긍정적 소식이 섞여 있습니다. 총리가 석유 밀수 관련으로 관리 9명을 해임했고, 키르쿠크 주지사가 선출된 것이 포함됩니다. 부정적 소식으로는 디나르화가 달러당 170,000을 넘어 약세를 보인 점, 예산과 세입을 둘러싼 분쟁, 국경 폐쇄 이후의 물가 상승, 그리고 베이루트에서 전 국회의원이 살해된 사건이 있습니다. GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 부정적이므로 점수는 중립보다 약간 낮습니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में नियमित शासन से जुड़ी खबरों के साथ कुछ हल्की सकारात्मक बातें भी शामिल हैं, जैसे तेल तस्करी की जांच के बाद प्रधानमंत्री द्वारा नौ अधिकारियों की बर्खास्तगी और किरकुक के गवर्नर का निर्वाचित होना। नकारात्मक पहलुओं में दीनार का प्रति डॉलर 170,000 से आगे कमजोर होना, बजट और राजस्व पर विवाद, सीमा बंद होने के बाद कीमतों में वृद्धि, और बेरूत में एक पूर्व सांसद की हत्या शामिल हैं। GDELT का स्वर विश्व औसत से अधिक नकारात्मक है, इसलिए स्कोर तटस्थ से थोड़ा नीचे है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει ρουτινικά νέα διακυβέρνησης με κάποιες ήπιες θετικές εξελίξεις, όπως η απόλυση εννέα αξιωματούχων από τον πρωθυπουργό λόγω της υπόθεσης λαθρεμπορίου πετρελαίου και η εκλογή του κυβερνήτη του Κιρκούκ. Στις αρνητικές εξελίξεις περιλαμβάνονται η υποτίμηση του δηναρίου πάνω από 170.000 ανά δολάριο, οι διαφορές για τον προϋπολογισμό και τα έσοδα, οι αυξήσεις τιμών μετά το κλείσιμο των συνόρων και η δολοφονία πρώην βουλευτή στη Βηρυτό. Ο τόνος του GDELT είναι πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται ελαφρώς κάτω από το ουδέτερο επίπεδο.

summary.en: In the last 24 hours, 408 people fell ill from contaminated water in Tshwane/Bronkhorstspruit. The rising cost of living and fuel pressure, the debate over the Eskom tariff increase, and the warning of losing AGOA also came to the fore. On the other side, there are positive developments such as Glencore's mining investment, the Durban marina project and Vodacom's network investment, and the GNU also survived a revolt within the ANC. The stock market fell by about 3.6% in one month, but the overall picture is not at crisis level and is slightly below normal.

en: 408 people fell ill from contaminated water in Bronkhorstspruit, and Tshwane's warning and chlorination efforts failed
Pressure from the cost of living and fuel prices, and reaction to the Eskom tariff increase
Warning to prepare for the loss of AGOA and uncertainty in relations with the United States
Investment news such as Glencore, Vodacom and the Durban marina
A 3.6% monthly decline on the stock market, with the tone of the news below average

summary.tr: Dönemde şiddet olayları ağırlıklı yer tutuyor; bunlar arasında süregelen yabancı düşmanı şiddete ilişkin haberler, bir çiftlik saldırısında bir 21 yaşındaki gencin işkenceyle öldürülmesi ve bir papazın ölümüne ilişkin protesto yer alıyor. summary.pt: O período é dominado por incidentes violentos, incluindo relatos de violência xenofóbica em curso, um assassinato com tortura em um ataque a uma fazenda e um protesto pela morte de um pastor. Notícias sobre negociações de coalizão e pressão sobre a presidência acrescentam tensão política, enquanto a bolsa de valores permanece praticamente estável e as notícias de esportes e negócios são rotineiras.
summary.ja: この期間は暴力事件が中心で、続いている外国人嫌悪の暴力に関する報道、農場襲撃での拷問殺害事件、牧師の死に抗議する デモなどが含まれます。連立協議と大統領への圧力に関する報道が政治的緊張を加えています。株式市場はほぼ横ばいで、スポーツとビジネスのニュースは通常どおりです。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 폭력 사건이 주를 이루며, 계속되는 외국인 혐오 폭력에 관한 보도, 농장 습격 사건에서 21세 남성이 고문 끝에 살해된 사건, 목사의 죽음에 항의하는 시위 등이 포함됩니다. 연립정부 협상과 대통령에 대한 압박 관련 보도는 정치적 긴장을 더하고 있습니다. 주식시장은 대체로 보합세이며, 스포츠 및 경제 뉴스는 평이한 수준입니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में हिंसक घटनाएँ प्रमुख रहीं, जिनमें जारी ज़ેनोफ़ोबिक हिंसा की रिपोर्टें, एक फ़ार्म हमले में यातना देकर की गई हत्या और एक पादरी की मौत के विरोध में प्रदर्शन शामिल हैं। गठबंधन वार्ता और राष्ट्रपति पर दबाव से जुड़ी खबरें राजनीतिक तनाव बढ़ाती हैं, जबकि शेयर बाज़ार लगभग स्थिर रहा और खेल व व्यापार की खबरें सामान्य रहीं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από βίαια περιστατικά, όπως αναφορές για συνεχιζόμενη ξενοφοβική βία, μια δολοφονία με βασανιστήρια σε επίθεση σε αγροτική έκταση και μια διαμαρτυρία για τον θάνατο ενός πάστορα. Οι ειδήσεις για τις συνομιλίες συνασπισμού και την πίεση προς τον πρόεδρο προσθέτουν πολιτική ένταση, ενώ το χρηματιστήριο παραμένει σχεδόν αμετάβλητο και τα αθλητικά και οικονομικά νέα είναι συνηθισμένα.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato da episodi di violenza, tra cui segnalazioni di violenza xenofoba in corso, un omicidio con tortura in un attacco a una fattoria e una protesta per la morte di un pastore. Le notizie sui negoziati di coalizione e sulle pressioni presidenziali aggiungono tensione politica, mentre il mercato azionario è sostanzialmente stabile e le notizie sportive ed economiche sono di routine.
summary.ru: В этот период доминируют насильственные инциденты, включая сообщения о продолжающемся ксенофобском насилии, убийстве с пытками в ходе нападения на ферму и протест в связи со смертью пастора. Новости о переговорах о коалиции и давлении на президента добавляют политической напряжённости, тогда как фондовый рынок находится примерно на прежнем уровне, а спортивные и деловые новости носят рутинный характер.
summary.ar: تهيمن على هذه الفترة حوادث العنف، بما في ذلك تقارير عن استمرار أعمال العنف المعادية للأجانب، وجريمة قتل بالتعذيب في هجوم على مزرعة، واحتجاج على وفاة قس. وتضيف أخبار مفاوضات الائتلاف والضغوط الرئاسية توتراً سياسياً، بينما يبقى سوق الأسهم مستقراً تقريباً، وأخبار الرياضة والأعمال روتينية.

summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più caratterizzato da notizie di routine su affari e istituzioni, con appalti per infrastrutture, profitti portuali e investimenti nelle telecomunicazioni. Sono presenti tensioni politiche: un sindaco di Douala convocato per alcune dichiarazioni, commenti dell'opposizione e un documento che esclude alcuni funzionari da un'elezione, oltre a un allarme sull'insicurezza alimentare. Il tono di GDELT è più negativo della media mondiale, quindi il punteggio si colloca leggermente al di sotto di una giornata ordinaria.
summary.ru: Период в основном состоит из рутинных деловых и институциональных новостей: контракты на инфраструктуру, портовая прибыль и инвестиции в телекоммуникации. Присутствует политическая напряжённость: вызов мэра Дуалы из-за высказываний, критика со стороны оппозиции и документ, исключающий некоторых чиновников из выборов, а также предупреждение о продовольственной небезопасности. Тон GDELT более негативен, чем среднемировой, поэтому оценка немного ниже обычного дня.
summary.ar: تتألف الفترة في معظمها من أخبار روتينية عن الأعمال والمؤسسات، تشمل عقود البنية التحتية وأرباح الموانئ والاستثمار في قطاع الاتصالات. وهناك توتر سياسي، إذ استُدعي عمدة دوالا بسبب تصريحات، وظهرت انتقادات من المعارضة، ووثيقة تستبعد بعض المسؤولين من انتخابات، إضافة إلى تحذير من انعدام الأمن الغذائي. ونبرة GDELT أكثر سلبية من متوسط العالم، لذا فإن الدرجة أدنى قليلاً من يوم عادي.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً شامل اخبار روتین تجاری و نهادی است، از جمله قراردادهای زیرساختی، سود بنادر و سرمایه‌گذاری در حوزه مخابرات. تنش سیاسی نیز وجود دارد: شهردار دوآلا برای اظهاراتی احضار شده، منتقدان مخالف اظهارنظر کرده‌اند و سندی برخی مسئولان را از یک انتخابات کنار گذاشته است. همچنین هشداری درباره ناامنی غذایی منتشر شده است. لحن GDELT منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است، بنابراین امتیاز اندکی پایین‌تر از یک روز عادی قرار دارد.
summary.zh: 该时段的新闻大多是常规的商业和机构动态，包括基础设施合同、港口利润和电信投资。政治紧张局势也有所体现：杜阿拉市长因言论被传唤，反对派发表评论，一份文件将部分官员排除在选举之外，同时还有一则粮食不安全预警。GDELT的情绪倾向比全球平均水平更为负面，因此得分略低于普通的一天。
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin iş ve kurumsal haberlerden oluşuyor: altyapı sözleşmeleri, liman kârları ve telekom yatırımları. Siyasi gerilim de mevcut: bir Douala belediye başkanının açıklamaları nedeniyle çağrılması, muhalefet yorumları ve bazı yetkililerin bir seçimden dışlanmasına ilişkin bir belge, ayrıca bir gıda güvensizliği uyarısı. GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasına göre daha olumsuz olduğundan, skor sıradan bir günün biraz altında yer alıyor.
summary.es: El periodo está compuesto en su mayoría por noticias empresariales e institucionales rutinarias, con contratos de infraestructura, beneficios portuarios e inversiones en telecomunicaciones. Existe tensión política: un alcalde de Duala convocado por sus declaraciones, comentarios de la oposición y un documento que excluye a algunos funcionarios de unas elecciones, además de una advertencia sobre inseguridad alimentaria. El tono de GDELT es más negativo que la media mundial, por lo que la puntuación queda ligeramente por debajo de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La période est essentiellement composée d'actualités économiques et institutionnelles courantes : contrats d'infrastructures, bénéfices portuaires et investissements dans les télécommunications. Des tensions politiques sont présentes : un maire de Douala convoqué à la suite de propos tenus, des commentaires de l'opposition et un document excluant certains responsables d'une élection, ainsi qu'une alerte sur l'insécurité alimentaire. Le ton de GDELT est plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale, ce qui place le score légèrement en dessous d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum besteht überwiegend aus routinemäßigen Wirtschafts- und Institutionennachrichten: Infrastrukturverträge, Hafengewinne und Investitionen in den Telekomsektor. Politische Spannungen sind ebenfalls vorhanden: Ein Bürgermeister aus Douala wurde wegen seiner Äußerungen vorgeladen, es gibt Kommentare der Opposition sowie ein Dokument, das einige Amtsträger von einer Wahl ausschließt, außerdem eine Warnung vor Ernährungsunsicherheit. Der GDELT-Ton ist negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt, weshalb der Wert leicht unter dem eines gewöhnlichen Tages liegt.
summary.pt: O período é composto sobretudo por notícias empresariais e institucionais de rotina: contratos de infraestrutura, lucros portuários e investimentos em telecomunicações. Há tensão política: um presidente da câmara de Douala convocado por declarações, comentários da oposição e um documento que exclui alguns funcionários de uma eleição, além de um alerta sobre insegurança alimentar. O tom do GDELT é mais negativo do que a média mundial, pelo que a pontuação fica ligeiramente abaixo de um dia comum.
summary.ja: この期間の報道は、インフラ契約、港湾収益、通信分野への投資など、主に日常的な企業・制度関連のニュースが中心です。政治的緊張も見られ、発言を理由にドゥアラ市長が召喚されたこと、野党によるコメント、一部の公職者を選挙から除外する文書、さらに食料不安に関する警告があります。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりもネガティブであり、そのためスコアは通常の一日よりやや低くなっています。
summary.ko: 이번 기간의 보도는 대체로 인프라 계약, 항만 수익, 통신 분야 투자 등 일상적인 기업 및 제도 관련 뉴스가 중심입니다. 정치적 긴장도 존재합니다. 발언을 이유로 두알라 시장이 소환되었고, 야당의 논평이 이어졌으며, 일부 공직자를 선거에서 배제하는 문서가 나왔습니다. 여기에 식량 불안 경고도 더해졌습니다. GDELT 톤은 세계 평균보다 부정적이어서, 점수가 평범한 하루보다 약간 낮게 나타납니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि की खबरें ज़्यादातर नियमित व्यावसायिक और संस्थागत प्रकृति की हैं, जिनमें बुनियादी ढांचा अनुबंध, बंदरगाह के मुनाफे और दूरसंचार निवेश शामिल हैं। राजनीतिक तनाव भी मौजूद है: एक बयान को लेकर डुआला के मेयर को तलब किया गया, विपक्ष की टिप्पणियाँ आईं, और एक दस्तावेज़ में कुछ अधिकारियों को चुनाव से बाहर रखा गया है, साथ ही खाद्य असुरक्षा की चेतावनी भी है। GDELT का लहजा वैश्विक औसत से अधिक नकारात्मक है, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से थोड़ा नीचे है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος καλύπτεται κυρίως από συνήθη επιχειρηματικά και θεσμικά νέα, με συμβάσεις υποδομών, κέρδη λιμανιών και επενδύσεις στις τηλεπικοινωνίες. Υπάρχει πολιτική ένταση: ο δήμαρχος του Duala κλητεύθηκε εξαιτίας δηλώσεών του, κυκλοφόρησαν σχόλια της αντιπολίτευσης και ένα έγγραφο που αποκλείει ορισμένους αξιωματούχους από εκλογή, ενώ υπάρχει και προειδοποίηση για επισιτιστική ανασφάλεια. Ο τόνος του GDELT είναι πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται ελαφρώς κάτω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.

summary.it: Il Canada presenta una giornata complessivamente positiva: i negoziati commerciali sono avanzati con le Filippine e l'ASEAN, sono stati segnalati progressi con gli Stati Uniti e sono stati annunciati investimenti di bilancio, mentre il TSX è stabile e il tono delle notizie è leggermente positivo. Gli elementi negativi (morti di soldati in un'esercitazione a fuoco, anniversario dell'alluvione in British Columbia, disagi al traffico aereo) sono isolati e non indicano tensioni istituzionali.
summary.ru: В Канаде день в целом позитивный: переговоры о торговле продвинулись с Филиппинами и АСЕАН, сообщается о прогрессе в переговорах с США, объявлены бюджетные инвестиции, индекс TSX стабилен, а тон новостей умеренно позитивный. summary.ar: تُظهر كندا يوماً إيجابياً بوجه عام: فقد تقدمت محادثات التجارة مع الفلبين ورابطة أمم جنوب شرق آسيا (آسيان)، وأُفيد بإحراز تقدم مع الولايات المتحدة، وأُعلنت استثمارات في الميزانية، بينما يبقى مؤشر بورصة تورونتو مستقراً ونبرة الأخبار إيجابية بشكل معتدل. والأخبار السلبية (مقتل جنود خلال تدريب بالذخيرة الحية، والذكرى السنوية لفيضان كولومبيا البريطانية، واضطراب الحركة الجوية) معزولة ولا تشير إلى ضغوط مؤسسية.
summary.fa: کانادا روز کلی مثبتی را پشت سر می‌گذارد: مذاکرات تجاری با فیلیپین و آسه‌آن پیشرفت کرده، از پیشرفت در مذاکرات با آمریکا خبر داده شده و سرمایه‌گذاری‌های بودجه‌ای اعلام شده است؛ شاخص TSX باثبات است و لحن اخبار اندکی مثبت است. موارد منفی (کشته شدن سربازان در تمرین شلیک زنده، سالگرد سیل بریتیش کلمبیا، اختلال در ترافیک هوایی) موردی و منزوی هستند و نشانه‌ای از فشار نهادی نیستند.
summary.zh: 加拿大当天总体形势积极：与菲律宾和东盟的贸易谈判取得进展，与美国的谈判据报道也有进展，并宣布了预算投资，多伦多证券交易所指数保持稳定，新闻基调略微正面。负面消息（军人在实弹训练中死亡、不列颠哥伦比亚省洪灾周年纪念、航空交通中断）属于个别事件，并不表明机构承压。
summary.tr: Kanada için genel olarak olumlu bir gün: Filipinler ve ASEAN ile ticaret görüşmeleri ilerledi, ABD ile ilerleme bildirildi ve bütçe yatırımları duyuruldu; TSX istikrarlı seyrediyor ve haberlerin tonu hafif olumlu. Olumsuz haberler (eğitim atışında asker ölümleri, B.C. sel yıldönümü, hava trafiğindeki aksama) münferit olup kurumsal bir gerilime işaret etmiyor.
summary.es: Canadá registra un día en general positivo: avanzaron las negociaciones comerciales con Filipinas y la ASEAN, se informó de progresos con Estados Unidos y se anunciaron inversiones presupuestarias, mientras el TSX se mantiene estable y el tono de las noticias es ligeramente positivo. Los hechos negativos (muertes de soldados en un ejercicio de tiro, aniversario de la inundación en B.C. y alteraciones en el tráfico aéreo) son aislados y no indican tensiones institucionales.
summary.fr: Le Canada affiche une journée globalement positive : les négociations commerciales avec les Philippines et l'ASEAN ont progressé, des avancées avec les États-Unis ont été signalées et des investissements budgétaires ont été annoncés, tandis que le TSX reste stable et le ton de l'actualité est légèrement positif. Les éléments négatifs (décès de militaires lors d'un exercice de tir, anniversaire de la crue en Colombie-Britannique, perturbations du trafic aérien) sont isolés et ne traduisent pas de tensions institutionnelles.
summary.de: Kanada verzeichnet einen insgesamt positiven Tag: Die Handelsgespräche mit den Philippinen und der ASEAN kamen voran, Fortschritte bei den Verhandlungen mit den USA wurden gemeldet und Budgetinvestitionen angekündigt, während der TSX stabil bleibt und der Nachrichtenton leicht positiv ist. Negative Meldungen (Tod von Soldaten bei einer Schießübung, Jahrestag der Überschwemmung in B.C., Störungen im Flugverkehr) sind vereinzelt und deuten nicht auf institutionelle Spannungen hin.
summary.pt: O Canadá registra um dia geralmente positivo: as negociações comerciais com as Filipinas e a ASEAN avançaram, foram reportados progressos com os EUA e foram anunciados investimentos orçamentários, enquanto a TSX se mantém estável e o tom das notícias é levemente positivo. Os itens negativos (mortes de soldados em exercício de tiro, aniversário da enchente na Colúmbia Britânica e interrupções no tráfego aéreo) são isolados e não sinalizam tensão institucional.
summary.ja: カナダでは全体的に前向きな一日となった。フィリピンおよびASEANとの貿易交渉が前進し、米国との交渉でも進展が報告され、予算投資が発表された。TSX（トロント証券取引所）は安定しており、ニュースの論調はやや前向きである。訓練中の射撃事故による兵士の死亡、ブリティッシュコロンビア州の洪水から1年の節目、航空交通の混乱といった否定的な出来事は個別的なものであり、制度上の緊張を示すものではない。
summary.ko: 캐나다는 전반적으로 긍정적인 하루였다. 필리핀 및 ASEAN과의 무역 협상이 진전되었고, 미국과의 협상에서도 진전이 보고되었으며, 예산 투자가 발표되었다. TSX는 보합세를 보였고 뉴스의 논조는 완만하게 긍정적이었다. 훈련 중 사격 사고로 인한 군인 사망, 브리티시컬럼비아주 홍수 1주년, 항공 교통 차질 등 부정적인 사안은 개별적인 사건이며 제도적 긴장을 시사하지 않는다.
summary.hi: कनाडा के लिए कुल मिलाकर सकारात्मक दिन रहा। फिलीपींस और आसियान के साथ व्यापार वार्ता आगे बढ़ी, अमेरिका के साथ वार्ता में प्रगति की रिपोर्ट मिली, और बजट निवेश की घोषणा हुई। टीएसएक्स स्थिर रहा और समाचार का स्वर हल्का सकारात्मक है। प्रशिक्षण के दौरान गोलीबारी में सैनिकों की मौत, ब्रिटिश कोलंबिया बाढ़ की वर्षगांठ और हवाई यातायात में व्यवधान जैसी नकारात्मक घटनाएँ अलग-थलग हैं और संस्थागत तनाव का संकेत नहीं देतीं।
summary.el: Ο Καναδάς είχε γενικά θετική ημέρα: οι εμπορικές διαπραγματεύσεις με τις Φιλιππίνες και την ASEAN προχώρησαν, αναφέρθηκε πρόοδος με τις ΗΠΑ και ανακοινώθηκαν επενδύσεις του προϋπολογισμού, ενώ ο TSX παραμένει σταθερός και ο τόνος των ειδήσεων είναι ελαφρώς θετικός. Τα αρνητικά γεγονότα (θάνατοι στρατιωτών σε εκπαιδευτική άσκηση πυροβολισμών, επέτειος των πλημμυρών της Βρετανικής Κολομβίας, διαταραχές της εναέριας κυκλοφορίας) είναι μεμονωμένα και δεν υποδηλώνουν θεσμική πίεση.

summary.it: Il periodo è di routine: un avviso meteorologico e temperature rigide a Ulan Bator, un incontro ministeriale con un consigliere presidenziale russo e notizie per lo più culturali o sportive. summary.ru: Период носит рутинный характер: метеопредупреждение и холодная погода в Улан-Баторе, встреча министра с помощником президента России и в основном культурные или спортивные новости. summary.ar: الفترة الزمنية روتينية: تحذير من الطقس وبرودة في أولان باتور، واجتماع وزاري مع مساعد للرئيس الروسي، وأخبار ثقافية ورياضية في معظمها. تتناول معظم الأخبار الصينية منطقة منغوليا الداخلية، وهي منطقة صينية، لذا فهي تقول القليل عن منغوليا نفسها، وتتسم نبرة GDELT بإيجابية طفيفة.
summary.fa: این دوره روال‌معمول است: هشدار هواشناسی و هوای سرد در اولان‌باتور، دیدار وزیر با یکی از دستیاران رئیس‌جمهور روسیه، و عمدتاً اخبار فرهنگی یا ورزشی. بیشتر گزارش‌های چینی‌زبان درباره منطقه مغولستان درونی، یک منطقه چینی، است، بنابراین درباره خود مغولستان چیز اندکی می‌گویند و لحن GDELT اندکی مثبت است.
summary.zh: 此时段属于常规报道：乌兰巴托发布天气预警并出现低温，部长会见俄罗斯总统助理，其余多为文化或体育新闻。多数中文报道涉及中国的内蒙古地区，因此对蒙古国本身着墨不多；GDELT语气略微正面。
summary.tr: Dönem rutin niteliktedir: Ulaanbaatar'da hava uyarısı ve soğuk hava koşulları, bir bakanın Rus cumhurbaşkanlığı yardımcısıyla görüşmesi ve çoğunlukla kültürel veya spor haberleri. Çince dilindeki haberlerin çoğu Çin'in bir bölgesi olan İç Moğolistan ile ilgilidir, bu nedenle Moğolistan'ın kendisi hakkında pek bir şey söylemezler ve GDELT tonu hafif olumludur.
summary.es: El periodo es rutinario: una alerta meteorológica y temperaturas frías en Ulán Bator, una reunión ministerial con un asesor presidencial ruso y, en su mayoría, noticias culturales o deportivas. La mayoría de las noticias en chino se refieren a Mongolia Interior, una región china, por lo que dicen poco sobre Mongolia en sí; el tono de GDELT es levemente positivo.
summary.fr: La période est routinière : un avertissement météorologique et des températures froides à Oulan-Bator, une réunion ministérielle avec un conseiller du président russe, et des informations majoritairement culturelles ou sportives. La plupart des articles en chinois concernent la Mongolie-Intérieure, une région chinoise, et disent donc peu de choses sur la Mongolie elle-même ; le ton GDELT est légèrement positif.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verlief routinemäßig: eine Wetterwarnung und kalte Temperaturen in Ulaanbaatar, ein Treffen eines Ministers mit einem Berater des russischen Präsidenten sowie überwiegend kulturelle oder sportliche Meldungen. Die meisten chinesischsprachigen Berichte betreffen die Innere Mongolei, eine chinesische Region, und sagen daher wenig über die Mongolei selbst aus; der GDELT-Tonfall ist leicht positiv.
summary.pt: O período é de rotina: um alerta meteorológico e temperaturas baixas em Ulaanbaatar, uma reunião ministerial com um assessor presidencial russo e, em sua maioria, notícias culturais ou esportivas. A maioria das notícias em chinês diz respeito à Mongólia Interior, uma região da China, por isso dizem pouco sobre a própria Mongólia; o tom do GDELT é levemente positivo.
summary.ja: この期間は日常的な内容が中心です。ウランバートルでの気象警報と低温、ロシア大統領補佐官とat大臣の会談、そしてほとんどが文化やスポーツに関する項目です。中国語の記事の多くは中国の地域である内モンゴルに関するものなので、モンゴル自体についてはあまり多くを語っていません。GDELTのトーンはわずかに肯定的です。
summary.ko: 이 기간은 일상적인 내용이 대부분입니다. 울란바토르의 기상 경보와 추운 날씨, 장관과 러시아 대통령 보좌관의 회담, 그리고 대부분 문화나 스포츠 관련 소식입니다. 중국어 기사 대부분은 중국의 한 지역인 내몽골과 관련되어 있어 몽골 자체에 대해서는 많이 다루지 않습니다. GDELT 어조는 약간 긍정적입니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि नियमित घटनाओं वाली है: उलानबातर में मौसम चेतावनी और ठंडा तापमान, एक मंत्री की रूसी राष्ट्रपति के सहायक के साथ बैठक, और अधिकतर सांस्कृतिक या खेल संबंधी समाचार। अधिकांश चीनी-भाषा की खबरें चीन के एक क्षेत्र, आंतरिक मंगोलिया, से संबंधित हैं, इसलिए वे मंगोलिया के बारे में बहुत कम बताती हैं। GDELT का स्वर हल्का सकारात्मक है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι συνηθισμένη: μια προειδοποίηση καιρού και χαμηλές θερμοκρασίες στο Ουλάν Μπατόρ, μια συνάντηση υπουργού με σύμβουλο του Ρώσου προέδρου και κυρίως πολιτιστικά ή αθλητικά θέματα. Τα περισσότερα κινεζόφωνα δημοσιεύματα αφορούν την Εσωτερική Μογγολία, μια κινεζική περιφέρεια, οπότε λένε λίγα για την ίδια τη Μογγολία. Ο τόνος του GDELT είναι ελαφρώς θετικός.
